qe: Which type of 'Radiation' has the highest penetrating power?
qh: किस प्रकार के 'विकिरण' में भेदन क्षमता (penetrating power) सबसे अधिक होती है?
e: Gama kirnein (gamma rays) vidyut-chumbakiya tarangein hoti hain jinme na dravyaman hota hai na aavesh, isliye ye vayumandal mein sabse zyada door tak jaati hain (kuchh metre lead ke aar-paar bhi) aur sabse adhik bhedan-shakti (penetrating power) rakhti hain. Alpha kirnein bhaari hoti hain (2 proton + 2 neutron), isliye hawa mein sirf kuchh centimetre jaati hain aur kagaz se ruk jaati hain; beta kirnein thodi halki hoti hain par aluminium ki patli chadar se ruk jaati hain. Isi karan radiation shield ke liye sisa (lead) istemal hota hai. Exam point: sabse jyada penetrating = gamma rays; sabse kam = alpha rays (bhedan-shakti: gamma > beta > alpha).

qe: What is 'Radiocarbon Dating' used to determine?
qh: 'रेडियोकार्बन डेटिंग' का उपयोग क्या निर्धारित करने के लिए किया जाता है?
o: Age of fossils and ancient wood
e: Radiocarbon dating mein paudhon aur jeevon ke shareer mein maujood Carbon-14 ki matara ka hisaab lagaya jaata hai; jeev jeete ji Carbon-14 ka santulan bana rehta hai, par mrityu ke baad wo 5730 sal ki ardhaayu (half-life) ke saath ghatta jaata hai - isliye bachi hui matara se mrityu ka samay nikala jaata hai. Isi vidhi se hadi, lakdi, kaagaz, mummi aur purane awshesh ki umar 50,000 sal tak batayi jaati hai. Uranium-lead dating purani chattanon ke liye, potassium-argon jwalamukhi chattanon ke liye hoti hai - Ye vikalp galat hain. Exam point: radiocarbon dating = Carbon-14 ki half-life (5730 sal) par aadhaarit, jisse jeev-avshesh aur lakdi ki umar ka pata chalta hai.

qe: Which radioactive element is used in 'Nuclear Reactors' as fuel?
qh: परमाणु रिएक्टरों में ईंधन के रूप में किस रेडियोधर्मी तत्व का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Bhatti (nuclear reactor) mein indhan ke roop mein Uranium-235 istemal hota hai, kyunki uske bhaari nucleus par dheemi (slow) neutron ki takkar se viyojan (fission) ho jaata hai aur sath hi 2-3 naye neutron chhoote hain, jisse shrinkhala (chain) kriya chalti rehti hai. Uranium-238 (prakritik uranium ka 99.3%) aise kaam nahi karta, isliye ushe samvardhit (enriched) kar ke U-235 ki matara badhai jaati hai. Thorium aur plutonium anya indhan hain (Th-232 aur Pu-239), par mukhya reactor fuel U-235 hai. Exam point: nuclear reactor ka mukhya indhan = Uranium-235 (U-235), jiska fission slow neutron se hota hai aur chain reaction chalata hai.

qe: What is 'Nuclear Fusion'?
qh: 'परमाणु संलयन' (Nuclear Fusion) क्या है?
e: Nuclear fusion mein do halke (light) nuclei milkar ek bhaari (heavy) nucleus banate hain, aur is kriya mein jo dravyaman ki kami hoti hai wo Einstein ke samikaran E = mc2 ke anusar prabal urja mein badal jaati hai - surya aur taaron ki urja ka yahi srot hai. Iske liye atyant uushma (temperature, 10^7 K ke aas-paas) chahiye hoti hai, kyunki dhanaveshi (positive) nuclei ka vikarshan (repulsion) todna padta hai. Fission (bhaari nucleus ka tootna), sanyojan (chemical bonding) ya vishleshan (decomposition) alag prakriyaayein hain - Ye vikalp galat hain. Exam point: nuclear fusion = halke nuclei ka jurna jo prabal urja dete hain (Surya mein hydrogen se helium banta hai); fission = bhaari nucleus ka tootna.

qe: What is the 'Unit' of Radioactivity?
qh: रेडियोधर्मिता की 'इकाई' क्या है?
e: Radioaktivta (radioactivity) maapne ke liye curie (Ci) ko shuruaati ikai ke roop mein istemal karte hain, jahan 1 curie = 3.7 x 10^10 viyojan (disintegrations) per second hota hai. SI ikai bequerel (Bq) hai, jisme 1 Bq = 1 viyojan per second; isliye 1 curie = 3.7 x 10^10 Bq. Roentgen vaikiran (radiation) ke exposure ka maap hai aur joule urja ki ikai hai - isliye wo radioaktivta ki ikai nahi hain. Dhyan rakhein: Marie aur Pierre Curie ne radium aur polonium khoja tha, isliye unke naam par ye ikai bani. Exam point: radioaktivta ki purani ikai = curie (1 Ci = 3.7 x 10^10 decay/s), SI ikai = bequerel (Bq).

qe: Which isotope is used for the treatment of 'Cancer' (Radiotherapy)?
qh: 'कैंसर' (रेडियोथेरेपी) के उपचार के लिए किस समस्थानिक का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Cobalt-60 (Co-60) ek gama-vaikiran (gamma emitter) hai jise cancer ki radiotherapy mein istemal karte hain, kyunki iski prabal bhedan-shakti cancer-koshikaon (tumour cells) ko nasht kar deti hai; isi karan 'gamma knife' aur tele-therapy machines mein Co-60 rakha jaata hai. Iodine-131 thyroid (ghengra) ke liye, radium-226 purane ilaaj ke liye aur Uranium-235 indhan ke liye istemal hota hai - Ye vikalp galat hain. Dhyan rakhein: gamma kirnein shareer mein gehre tak pahunchti hain, isliye gehri tumouron ke liye upyukt hain. Exam point: cancer therapy ke liye istemal hone wala isotope = Cobalt-60 (gamma emitters); thok (external) radiotherapy ka mukhya srot.

qe: What is 'Nuclear Fission' used for in an Atomic Bomb?
qh: परमाणु बम में 'परमाणु विखंडन' का उपयोग किस लिए किया जाता है?
e: Atomic bomb mein Uranium-235 ya Plutonium-239 ka asanrakshit (uncontrolled) shrinkhala-abhikarmak (chain reaction) hota hai - ek neutron ka viyojan karne par 2-3 neutron chhoote hain, jo aage naye viyojan karte hain aur bahut kam samay mein prabal urja nikal jaati hai. Yahi karan hai ki bomb mein vismarak (explosive) asar hota hai, jabki reactor mein control rods se neutron sokh kar kritik (critical) avastha par kriya sthir rakhi jaati hai. Fusion (hydrogen bomb ka aadhaar), radioaktiv kshaya (decay) aur vaidyut (chemical) jalna iska aadhaar nahi hain. Exam point: atomic bomb = asanrakshit fission chain reaction (U-235 ya Pu-239); reactor mein yahi kriya niyantrit (controlled) roop mein chalti hai.

qe: Which rays are 'Positively' charged?
qh: कौन सी किरणें 'धनावेशित' होती हैं?
e: Alpha kirnein helium ke nucleus (2 proton + 2 neutron) ki tarah hoti hain, isliye ye dhanaveshit (positively charged) hoti hain aur vidyut-chumbakiya kshetra mein rin dhrub (negative plate) ki taraf khinchti hain. Beta kirnein electron ki tarah rinaveshit (negatively charged) hoti hain aur gamma kirnein bina aavesh (neutral) hoti hain, isliye unpar vidyut kshetra ka asar nahi hota. Isi gun se Rutherford ne in kirnon ko pehchana tha. Exam point: dhanaveshit (positive) rays = alpha rays; beta rinaveshit (negative) hoti hain aur gamma udasin (neutral) - isliye gamma vidyut kshetra se mudti nahi.

qe: Which isotope is used to treat 'Goiter' (Thyroid disorder)?
qh: 'घेंघा' (थायरॉयड विकार) के इलाज के लिए किस समस्थानिक का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Thyroid gland ko iodine chahiye hota hai (hormone banane ke liye), isliye Iodine-131 (beta-gamma emitters) atomi (selectively) thyroid mein jama hota hai aur uski vaikiran ati-aktiv (overactive) thyroid ke ootak ko nasht kar deti hai - isi karan ghengra (goitre) aur thyroid cancer ke ilaaj mein iska istemal hota hai. Cobalt-60 gehri thos tumouron ke liye, Sodium-24 khoon ke bahav ke liye aur Carbon-14 dating ke liye istemal hote hain - Ye vikalp galat hain. Exam point: ghengra (thyroid/goitre) ke ilaaj ka isotope = Iodine-131; kyunki thyroid iodine sokh leta hai, isliye radioactive iodine wahi pahunchta hai.

qe: What is 'Heavy Water' used as in a nuclear reactor?
qh: परमाणु रिएक्टर में 'भारी जल' (D2O) का उपयोग किस रूप में किया जाता है?
e: Bhaari paani (heavy water, D2O) reactor mein neutron-sanchodhak (moderator) ka kaam karta hai - ye tez (fast) neutron ko dheema (slow) kar deta hai bina unhe grahan kiye, jisse U-235 ka fission sambhav ho paaye; isi karan PHWR (pressurised heavy water reactor, jaise CANDU aur Bharat ke reactors) mein iska istemal hota hai. Ye indhan (fuel), control rod ya shield nahi hai - Ye vikalp galat hain. Dhyan rakhein: deuterium (2H) ki hone ke karan isme neutron kama (kam) sokhe jaate hain aur chain reaction chalti rehti hai. Exam point: heavy water reactor mein moderator (aur coolant) ka kaam karta hai, kyunki ye neutron dheema karta hai par grahan nahi karta.

qe: Which radiation is 'Negative' in nature?
qh: कौन सा विकिरण प्रकृति में 'ऋणात्मक' है?
e: Beta kshaya (decay) mein nucleus ka ek neutron proton mein badal jaata hai aur ek electron (beta particle) bahar nikalta hai, isliye beta kirnein rinaveshit (negative) hoti hain aur vidyut-chumbakiya kshetra mein dhan dhrub (positive plate) ki taraf khinchti hain - yahi inki pehchaan hai. Alpha kirnein dhanaveshit hain, gamma udasin (neutral) hain, aur positron dhanaveshit hota hai - isliye wo vikalp beta ke liye sahi nahi hain. Isi karan beta kshaya ke baad parmaanu kramank (atomic number) 1 badh jaata hai par dravyaman kramank (mass number) wahi rehta hai. Exam point: rinaveshit (negative) vaikiran = beta rays (electron), jo neutron ke proton mein badalne se nikalta hai.

qe: Who discovered 'Radioactivity'?
qh: 'रेडियोधर्मिता' की खोज किसने की थी?
e: Radioaktivta ki khoj Henri Becquerel ne 1896 mein ki thi - unhone uranium lavan ko andhere mein bhi vaikiran chhodte dekha; isi ke baad Marie Curie aur Pierre Curie ne radium aur polonium ke baare mein kaam kiya. Rutherford ne nucleus ki khoj ki, Chadwick ne neutron ki khoj ki, aur Einstein ne samikaran E = mc2 di - Ye vikalp galat hain. Dhyan rakhein: Henri Becquerel ki is khoj se hi nuclear vigyaan ki shuruat mani jaati hai. Exam point: radioaktivta ka avishkar = Henri Becquerel (1896); yahi khoj Madame Curie ke kaam ka aadhaar bani.

qe: Which 'Control Rods' are used to absorb neutrons in nuclear reactors?
qh: परमाणु रिएक्टरों में न्यूट्रॉन को अवशोषित करने के लिए किन 'नियंत्रण छड़ों' का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Reactor mein control rods (niyantran chhad) neutron ko sokhkar shrinkhala kriya ki gati kam kar deti hain, aur inhe cadmium ya boron se banaya jaata hai kyunki ye neutron ko bahut prabal tarike se grahan (absorb) karte hain. Isi karan jab shrinkhala kriya tez ho jaaye to control rods ko andar daala jaata hai aur reactor ruk jaata hai. Uranium aur plutonium indhan hain, graphite aur bhaari paani moderator hain, aur sisa shield hai - Ye vikalp galat hain. Exam point: control rods mein cadmium ya boron hote hain, jo neutron grahan karke reactor ki gati ko niyantrit (controlled) rakhte hain.

qe: What is 'Artificial Radioactivity' discovered by?
qh: 'कृत्रिम रेडियोधर्मिता' की खोज किसके द्वारा की गई थी?
e: Artificial radioactivity yani manav-nirmit radioaktivta ki khoj 1934 mein Irene Curie (Marie Curie ki putri) aur unke pati F. Joliot ne ki thi - unhone aluminium ko alpha particles se bombaard kar ke ek naya radioaktiv samsthiti bana diya. Rutherford ne 1919 mein pehla artificial transmutation (manav-nirmit parivartan) dikhaya, par 'artificial radioactivity' ka shrey Joliot-Curie dmpati ko milta hai. Fermi neutron-utprerit prakriyaon ke liye jane jaate hain. Exam point: artificial radioactivity ka avishkar = Irene Curie aur F. Joliot; inhe isi khoj par Nobel puraskar mila.

qe: Which radioactive series is also known as the 'Thorium Series'?
qh: किस रेडियोधर्मी श्रृंखला को 'थोरियम श्रृंखला' के रूप में भी जाना जाता है?
e: Thorium decay series ko 4n series kehte hain kyunki iske har member ka dravyaman kramank (mass number) 4 ke gunaank ke roop mein likha ja sakta hai jab thorium (Th-232) se shuruat hoti hai - isi tarah 3n wali series neptunium aur 4n+2 wali uranium-radium series kahalati hai. Isi karan series ka naam uske shuruaati nucleus ke mass number ke formula par padta hai. Polonium series ya radium series baad ke members ke naam par banti hain, isliye wo vikalp sahi jod nahi. Exam point: thorium series = 4n series (Th-232), uranium series = 4n+2, aur neptunium series = 4n+1.

qe: What is 'Hydrogen Bomb' based on?
qh: 'हाइड्रोजन बम' किस पर आधारित है?
e: Hydrogen bomb (thermonuclear bomb) nuclear fusion par aadhaarit hai - isme pehle fission se atyadhik uushma paida hoti hai, jisse hydrogen ke samsthiti (deuterium aur tritium) mil kar helium banate hain aur aseem urja nikalti hai. Yahi karan hai ki hydrogen bomb ki vismarak shakti atomic bomb se kai guna zyada hoti hai (fusion ki urja-dhanai zyada hoti hai). Fission (atomic bomb), radioaktiv kshaya aur vaidyut abhikarmak iska mukhya aadhaar nahi hain - Ye vikalp galat hain. Exam point: hydrogen bomb = nuclear fusion (deuterium + tritium se helium), jabki atomic bomb = nuclear fission (U-235/Pu-239).

qe: Which radiation travels with the 'Speed of Light'?
qh: कौन सा विकिरण 'प्रकाश की गति' से चलता है?
e: Gamma kirnein vidyut-chumbakiya tarangein hoti hain (prakash jaisi), isliye ye nirvaat (vacuum) mein bhi prakash ki gati (3 x 10^8 m/s) se chalti hain - kyunki inme dravyaman shunya hota hai aur ye photon ke roop mein vyavhaar karti hain. Alpha aur beta kirnein kan (particles) hain jinme kuchh dravyaman hota hai, isliye wo prakash se dheeme chalti hain (beta lagbhag 0.9c tak). Neutron bhI ek kan hai, isliye 'speed of light' wala gun sirf gamma ka hai. Exam point: gamma kirnein prakash ki gati se chalti hain kyunki ye vidyut-chumbakiya tarangein (photon) hain, kan nahi.

qe: What is 'SI Unit' of activity of a radioactive substance?
qh: रेडियोधर्मी पदार्थ की सक्रियता की 'SI इकाई' क्या है?
e: Kisi bhi radioaktiv padarth ki active-ta (activity) ki SI ikai bequerel (Bq) hai, jahan 1 bequerel = 1 kshaya (decay) per second hota hai - iska naam Henri Becquerel ke naam par pada. Purani ikai curie (Ci) hai jisme 1 Ci = 3.7 x 10^10 Bq hota hai. Gray aur sievert absorbed dose aur dose-equivalent ke liye hote hain (ye sharir par pade asar ka maap hain), isliye wo activity ki ikai nahi. Exam point: activity ki SI ikai = bequerel (1 decay/second); purani ikai curie (1 Ci = 3.7 x 10^10 Bq).

qe: Which reaction is used in 'Sun' to produce energy?
qh: ऊर्जा उत्पन्न करने के लिए 'सूर्य' में कौन सी अभिक्रिया होती है?
e: Surya mein urja nuclear fusion se banti hai - isme proton-proton shrinkhala (chain) mein hydrogen ke nuclei mil kar helium banate hain, aur dravyaman ka thoda ansh E = mc2 ke anusar aseem urja mein badal jaata hai. Isi liye Surya mein hydrogen se helium banne ki speed aur garmi ka santulan bana rehta hai (4 hydrogen nuclei se 1 helium banta hai). Fission, radioaktiv kshaya ya jalna (combustion) iska aadhaar nahi hain, Ye vikalp galat hain. Exam point: Surya aur taaron ki urja ka srot = nuclear fusion (hydrogen se helium banana), fission se nahi.

qe: Which device is used to measure 'Radioactivity'?
qh: 'रेडियोधर्मिता' को मापने के लिए किस उपकरण का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Radioaktivta maapne ke liye Geiger-Muller counter istemal hota hai - ismein ek gas-bhari nal (tube) hoti hai jisme vaikiran aane par gas ionise hoti hai aur bijli ka pulse banta hai, jise meter ya beep se pata chal jaata hai. Isi karan khade-khaanon aur nuclear plant mein suraksha ke liye yahi yantra rakha jaata hai. Scintillation counter bhi kaam aata hai par sabse aam udaharan GM counter hi hai. Thermometer tapman, barometer dabav aur voltameter vidyut ke liye hote hain - Ye vikalp galat hain. Exam point: radioactivity maapne ka yantra = Geiger-Muller counter; ye vaikiran se gas ke ionisation ko gin-tar (count) karta hai.

qe: Which 'Sub-atomic' particle is emitted during Beta decay?
qh: बीटा क्षय के दौरान कौन सा 'उप-परमाणु' कण उत्सर्जित होता है?
e: Beta kshaya mein neutron apna roop badal kar proton ban jaata hai; is badlav mein ek rin-aaveshi kan - electron hi - nucleus se bahar nikalta hai, isliye beta particle ko electron kaha jaata hai (saath mein ek antineutrino bhi nikalta hai). Alpha kshaya mein helium nucleus nikalta hai, gamma kshaya mein photon nikalta hai aur positron kshaya mein dhan-aaveshi electron nikalta hai - isliye wo vikalp beta ke liye sahi nahi hain. Exam point: beta kshaya mein nikalne wala kan = electron (beta particle), jo neutron ke proton mein badalne se paida hota hai.

qe: Which isotope is used to study 'Photosynthesis'?
qh: 'प्रकाश संश्लेषण' का अध्ययन करने के लिए किस समस्थानिक का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Photosynthesis ke antargat paudhe carbon dioxide se carbon lekar chini (glucose) banate hain, isliye Carbon-14 (radioactive carbon) paudhon ko diya jaaye to wo carbon ke raste se hokar glucose mein pahunchta hai aur vaikiran se pata chalta hai ki kaun se padarth bane. Isi vidhi se Calvin cycle aur paudhon ke metabolism ke raaste khoje gaye. Iodine-131 thyroid ke liye, Phosphorus-32 DNA/RNA ke liye aur Sodium-24 khoon ke bahav ke liye istemal hota hai - Ye vikalp galat hain. Exam point: photosynthesis ke adhyayan ka isotope = Carbon-14, kyunki ye carbon ke roop mein glucose banaane ke raste mein shamil ho jaata hai.

qe: What is 'Radioactive Equilibrium'?
qh: 'रेडियोधर्मी संतुलन' क्या है?
o: Rate of decay = Rate of formation
e: Radioactive equilibrium wo avastha hai jab kisi radioactive padarth ka banne ki gati (rate of formation) aur tootne ki gati (rate of decay) barabar ho jaati hai, isliye uske atom ki sankhya sthir ho jaati hai (ise transient ya secular equilibrium bhi kehte hain). Yahi karan hai ki uranium khaniz mein radium ki matara saloon tak wahi rehti hai - kyunki uranium se banne wala radium utni hi gati se tootta bhi hai. Decay ka ruk jaana ya tapman badalna is avastha ki paribhasha nahi hai. Exam point: radioactive equilibrium = jaise hi radioactive padarth ban raha hai, wahi matara toot bhi raha hai; isliye matara sthir rehti hai.

qe: What is 'Critical Mass' in a nuclear chain reaction?
qh: परमाणु श्रृंखला अभिक्रिया में 'क्रांतिक द्रव्यमान' (Critical Mass) क्या है?
e: Critical mass wo nyoonatam (minimum) matara hai jiske hone par fission mein chhoote (released) neutron agle fission karne ke liye kaafi hote hain aur shrinkhala kriya khudi chalti rehti hai; isse kam matara par neutron bhaag jaate hain aur kriya ruk jaati hai. Isi liye atomic bomb mein U-235/Pu-239 ki matara critical mass se adhik rakhi jaati hai aur reactor mein control rods se kriya sthir rakhi jaati hai. Critical mass ka 'nuclear fuel ki kshamta', 'half-life' ya 'neutron ki urja' se sidha matlab nahi hai. Exam point: critical mass = wo nyoonatam matara jis par self-sustaining (khud chalti) chain reaction sambhav ho jaaye; isse kam par kriya ruk jaati hai.

qe: What is 'Alpha' particle deficiency effect on Atomic Number?
qh: परमाणु संख्या पर 'अल्फा' कण की कमी का क्या प्रभाव पड़ता है?
e: Alpha kshaya mein nucleus se 2 proton aur 2 neutron (ek helium nucleus) nikal jaate hain, isliye parmaanu kramank (atomic number) 2 kam ho jaata hai aur dravyaman kramank (mass number) 4 kam ho jaata hai; isi karan alpha kshaya ke baad naya element periodic table mein do sthaan peeche chala jaata hai. Beta kshaya mein atomic number 1 badhta hai (mass number wahi) aur gamma emission mein dono nahi badalte - Ye vikalp galat hain. Udaharan: uranium-238 se thorium-234 (90 se 88). Exam point: alpha kshaya mein atomic number 2 ghatta hai aur mass number 4 ghatta hai (2 proton + 2 neutron nikalne se).

qe: What happens to the Mass Number during 'Beta' decay?
qh: 'बीटा' क्षय के दौरान द्रव्यमान संख्या का क्या होता है?
e: Beta kshaya mein nucleus ka neutron proton mein badal jaata hai aur electron bahar nikal jaata hai; kyunki ek neutron (n) se ek proton (p) banta hai, nucleons ki kul sankhya (proton + neutron) wahi rehti hai, isliye mass number nahi badalta - sirf atomic number 1 badh jaata hai. Isi karan carbon-14 se nitrogen-14 banta hai (dono ka mass number 14). Alpha kshaya mein mass number 4 ghatta hai aur gamma emission mein kuchh nahi badalta, isliye wo vikalp beta ke liye sahi nahi hain. Exam point: beta kshaya mein mass number wahi rehta hai, sirf atomic number 1 badhta hai (neutron se proton banta hai).

qe: Which rays have the 'Least' ionizing power?
qh: किन किरणों में 'न्यूनतम' आयनकारी शक्ति होती है?
e: Gamma kirnein vidyut-chumbakiya tarangein hoti hain jinme na aavesh hota hai na dravyaman, isliye ye kisi bhi padarth ke atom ko seedhe ionise nahi kar paati (ye secondary electrons ke zariye thoda asar deti hain) - isi karan inki ionising shakti sabse kam hoti hai. Alpha kirnein bhaari aur dhanaveshit hone ke karan sabse zyada ionise karti hain (hawa mein sirf kuchh cm jaati hain), beta madhyam karti hain. Isliye 'gamma' yahan sahi jod hai. Exam point: ionising power ka kram: alpha > beta > gamma; gamma sabse kam ionise karti hai par sabse zyada bhedan (penetrate) karti hai.

qe: What is 'Nuclear Binding Energy'?
qh: 'परमाणु बंधन ऊर्जा' क्या है?
o: Energy to break a nucleus into nucleons
e: Nucleus ke andar proton aur neutron ko bandhe rakhne ke liye jo urja chahiye hoti hai, wahi nuclear binding energy hai - yani nucleus ko uske alag-alag nucleons mein todne ke liye di jane wali urja. Ise mass defect se E = mc2 ke roop mein nikala jaata hai, aur prati nucleon binding energy batati hai ki nucleus kitna sthir hai (iron-56 sabse sthir). Fission (tootna), fusion (jurna) ya vaikiran (radiation) iski paribhasha nahi hain - Ye vikalp galat hain. Exam point: nuclear binding energy = nucleus ko nucleons mein todne ke liye chahiye urja; ye mass defect aur E = mc2 se nikalti hai.

qe: What is the 'Order' of Radioactive Decay?
qh: रेडियोधर्मी क्षय की 'कोटि' (Order) क्या है?
e: Radioaktiv kshaya (decay) ek pratham koti (first order) kriya hoti hai, kyunki kshaya ki gati us samay maujood atomon ki sankhya par seedha nirbhar karti hai (rate proportional to N) - isliye iska rate constant matrak s^-1 hota hai. Yahi karan hai ki half-life padarth ki shuruaati matara se svatantra hoti hai aur har padarth ki apni sthir half-life hoti hai (jaise C-14 ki 5730 sal). Zero, second ya third order kshaya ke liye sahi nahi hain. Exam point: radioactive decay first-order kinetics follow karta hai; iske liye rate = k x N aur half-life sthir (0.693/k) hoti hai.

qe: Which reaction represents 'Nuclear Fission'?
qh: कौन सी अभिक्रिया 'परमाणु विखंडन' को दर्शाती है?
e: U-235 par dheema neutron girne se wo bhaari nucleus toot kar barium aur krypton jaise madhyam dravyaman ke tukde deta hai, aur sath hi 2-3 naye neutron chhodta hai - yahi fission ka samikaran hai, jisse aage chain reaction chalti hai. Isliye ye samikaran nuclear fission darshata hai. Iske ulat fusion ke samikaran mein halke nuclei jodkar bhaari nucleus banate hain, alpha kshaya mein helium nucleus nikalta hai aur beta kshaya mein electron nikalta hai - Ye vikalp galat hain. Exam point: fission ka samikaran: U-235 + n se Ba + Kr + 3n (dheema neutron se toot kar naye neutron deta hai, jisse chain reaction chalti hai).

qe: Which metal is used as 'Radiation Shield' due to its high density?
qh: उच्च घनत्व के कारण किस धातु का उपयोग 'विकिरण ढाल' (Radiation Shield) के रूप में किया जाता है?
e: Radiation se bachne ke liye hospital aur nuclear-lab ki deewaron aur apron mein sisa (lead) ki parat lagai jaati hai - sisa ki uchch ghanatva aur bada atomic number gamma kirnon ko gehre tak jaane nahi dete. Aluminium ki patli chadar beta ko rok deti hai par gamma ke liye kaafi nahi, tamba ya pittal bhi halka padta hai, aur kagaz-plastic to alpha ke liye bhi kaafi nahi hote. Isi karan uchch-urja (high energy) gamma ke liye sisa hi pasand kiya jaata hai. Exam point: gamma vaikiran rokne ke liye sisa (lead) sabse upyukt shield hai, kyunki wo ghana aur bhaari hone ke karan vaikiran ko andar tak nahi jaane deta.

qe: What is the unit of 'Activity' named after Marie Curie?
qh: मैरी क्यूरी के नाम पर 'एक्टिविटी' की इकाई क्या है?
e: Curie ikai ka naam Marie Curie aur Pierre Curie ke naam par pada, kyunki unhone 1898 mein radium aur polonium khoja tha aur radioaktivta ke adhyayan mein mool kaam kiya; isliye activity ki ikai ko 'curie' kehte hain (1 Ci = 3.7 x 10^10 decay/s). Yahi karan hai ki Marie Curie ko do Nobel puraskar mile (physics 1903 aur chemistry 1911). Becquerel ne radioaktivta khoji thi, par ikai ka naam Curie par pada aur SI ikai bequerel ke naam par hai. Exam point: activity ki purani ikai curie = Marie Curie ke naam par; SI ikai bequerel = Henri Becquerel ke naam par.

qe: What is the 'Mass Defect' of a nucleus?
qh: नाभिक की 'द्रव्यमान क्षति' (Mass Defect) क्या है?
o: Difference between sum of nucleons and actual nuclear mass
e: Mass defect ka matlab hai ki nucleus ke andar maujood nucleons ke alag-alag dravyaman ka jod aur nucleus ke asli dravyaman ke beech ka antar - ye dravyaman urja ban kar nikal chuka hota hai (E = mc2). Yahi mass defect nucleus ki sthirta (binding energy) darshata hai; bhaari nuclei mein prati nucleon binding energy alag hoti hai. Alpha kan ki matara, electron ka dravyaman ya isotope ka aayatan iski paribhasha nahi hain. Exam point: mass defect = nucleons ke alag dravyaman ka jod minus nucleus ka asli dravyaman; isi se binding energy E = mc2 nikalti hai.

qe: Which radioactive isotope is used to study 'Plant Photosynthesis' mechanisms?
qh: 'पौधों के प्रकाश संश्लेषण' की क्रियाविधि का अध्ययन करने के लिए किस रेडियोधर्मी समस्थानिक का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Paudhon ke andar carbon ke raste (photosynthesis ke kadam) ko samajhne ke liye radioactive C-14 ka istemal hota hai: C-14 diye gaye paudhe mein bane padarth (glucose, starch) alag kar ke unki vaikiran maapi jaati hai, isse pata chalta hai ki carbon kis kadam par kis padarth mein shamil hota hai (Calvin cycle). O-18 wale paani se ye bhi pata chala ki nikalne wali oxygen paani ke viyojan (photolysis) se aati hai, CO2 se nahi. Sodium-24 khoon ke bahav ke liye aur Iodine-131 thyroid ke liye hota hai, isliye wo yahan sahi jod nahi hain. Exam point: paudhon ke photosynthesis ke mekanizm ko tracer ke roop mein samajhne ka isotope = Carbon-14, jo carbon ke raste ko darshata hai.

qe: What is 'Nuclear Transmutation' by Alpha particles called in the Rutherford experiment?
qh: रदरफोर्ड के प्रयोग में अल्फा कणों द्वारा 'परमाणु तत्वान्तरण' को क्या कहा जाता है?
e: Rutherford ke experiment mein alpha particles (helium nuclei) nitrogen jaise halke nucleus se takra kar (alpha, proton) reaction dete hain - yani alpha particle ka absorption hokar proton nikalta hai, isliye ise (a, p) reaction kehte hain. Isi tarah (a, n), (p, n) jaise anya transmutation reactions bhi likhe jaate hain. Beta/gamma emission ya fission is khaas naam se nahi jude. Exam point: alpha se hui nuclear transmutation = (a, p) reaction, jisme alpha particle le jaaya jaata hai aur proton nikalta hai (Rutherford ka pehla artificial transmutation).

qe: Which 'Part' of the nuclear reactor carries heat away from the core to the turbines?
qh: परमाणु रिएक्टर का कौन सा 'भाग' कोर से टर्बाइन तक ऊष्मा ले जाता है?
e: Reactor ke core mein banti garmi ko bahar le jaane ke liye coolant istemal hota hai, jisse paani ki bhaap banti hai jo turbine ko ghumati hai aur bijli paida hoti hai; isi karan bhaari paani, saadhaaran paani, CO2 gas ya drav sodium (liquid sodium) coolant ke roop mein istemal hote hain. Control rods neutron sokhte hain, moderator neutron dheema karta hai aur shield vaikiran rokta hai - Ye vikalp galat hain. Yaad rakhein: coolant garmi ko saath le jaata hai, isliye wo core ke bahar aakar bhaap ya turbine ko garmi deta hai. Exam point: core ki garmi ko turbine tak pahunchane wala bhaag = coolant (jaise bhaari paani ya liquid sodium).

qe: What is the 'Range' of Alpha particles in air?
qh: हवा में अल्फा कणों की 'परास' (Range) कितनी होती है?
e: Alpha kan bhaari hota hai (2 proton + 2 neutron) aur uski ionising shakti bahut zyada hoti hai, isliye wo hawa ke atoms se jaldi-jaldi takra kar urja khota hai aur hawa mein sirf kuchh centimetre (2-10 cm) tak jaata hai - isi karan alpha ki range sabse kam hai. Beta kan halka hota hai to kuchh metre jaata hai, aur gamma ki range sabse zyada hoti hai. Sabse kam range wale kan ko kagaz ya kapde ke ek patal se rok diya jaata hai. Exam point: alpha particles ki hawa mein range sirf kuchh centimetre (2-10 cm) hoti hai kyunki ye bhaari hain aur urja jaldi khote hain.

qe: Which radiation is used in 'Brachytherapy' for internal cancer treatment?
qh: आंतरिक कैंसर उपचार के लिए 'ब्रेकीथेरेपी' में किस विकिरण का उपयोग किया जाता है?
o: Gamma rays from isotopes placed inside the body
e: Brachytherapy mein radioactive isotope (jaise Cobalt-60 ya Iridium-192) ko chhote 'seeds' ke roop mein cancer ke andar ya bahut paas rakh diya jaata hai, isliye vaikiran seedhe ootak (tumour) par asar karti hai aur bahari healthy ootak bacha rehta hai - yahi iska bada fayda hai. Bahari vaikiran (external beam therapy) se alag, isme isotope shareer ke andar daala jaata hai. Alpha/beta kirnein gehre ootak tak nahi pahunch paati, isliye wo brachytherapy ke liye upyukt nahi hain. Exam point: brachytherapy = shareer ke andar rakhe isotope (Cobalt-60/Iridium-192) ki gamma kirnon se cancer ka ilaaj, jisse healthy ootak bachta hai.

qe: What is 'Nuclear Fusion' ignition temperature approximately?
qh: 'परमाणु संलयन' शुरू करने के लिए आवश्यक तापमान लगभग कितना है?
e: Nuclear fusion ke liye bahut uchch tapman (lagbhag 10^7 se 10^8 kelvin) chahiye hota hai, kyunki dhanaveshit nuclei ka vidyut vikarshan (repulsion) todkar unhe itna paas laana padta hai ki nuclear force kaam kare; isi liye fusion ko 'thermonuclear' kriya kehte hain aur ye Surya ke andar saakshi ho jaata hai. Bahut kam tapman par fusion ho hi nahi paati (jab kuchh gas itni garam ho jaaye tab hi ye kriya shuru hoti hai). Fission ke liye kam tapman chahiye (kamre ke tapman par bhi shuru ho jaati hai) aur jalne ke liye sirf kuchh sau degree. Exam point: fusion ke liye lagbhag 10^7 - 10^8 K tapman chahiye (bhaari nuclei ke vikarshan ko todne ke liye) - isliye ise thermonuclear fusion kehte hain.

qe: Which radioactive isotope is used in 'Industrial Radiography' to check welds in metal?
qh: धातु में वेल्डिंग की जांच करने के लिए 'औद्योगिक रेडियोग्राफी' में किस रेडियोधर्मी समस्थानिक का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Industrial radiography mein welds aur dhaatu ke hisso ki andaruni (internal) jaanch ke liye gamma kirnon ka istemal hota hai - sabse aam isotope Cobalt-60 (aur Iridium-192) hote hain, kyunki unki prabal gamma kirnein dhaatu ke aar-paar jaakar film par chhap deti hain aur dirar (cracks) dikha deti hain. Iodine-131 aur Carbon-14 kam urja wale hote hain aur gehri dhaatu ke aar-paar nahi jaate. Isi karan welding ki quality jaanchne ke liye ise use karte hain. Exam point: metal welding ki jaanch (industrial radiography) ke liye = Cobalt-60 ya Iridium-192, kyunki inki gamma kirnein dhaatu ke aar-paar jaakar film par dirar dikhati hain.

qe: What is 'Nuclear Relaxation'?
qh: 'परमाणु विश्रांति' (Nuclear Relaxation) क्या है?
o: Return of excited nucleus to ground state
e: Nuclear relaxation (nuclear magnetic resonance mein) ka matlab hai ki bahari chumbakiya kshetra (magnetic field) hatane ke baad uttejit (excited) nucleus wapas apni mool (ground) avastha mein aa jaata hai aur urja chhod deta hai - isi signal se MRI (magnetic resonance imaging) ki chhavi banti hai. Isliye ye parmaanu sanyojan (nuclear fusion/fission) se alag vishay hai, aur vaikiran ka kshaya bhi nahi hai. Isi karan MRI mein tage (radio waves) aur chumbak ka istemal hota hai, hazard wali vaikiran ka nahi. Exam point: nuclear relaxation = uttejit (excited) nucleus ka wapas mool avastha mein lautna; isi principle par NMR aur MRI kaam karte hain.

qe: Which 'Law' relates the mass defect to the binding energy?
qh: द्रव्यमान क्षति को बंधन ऊर्जा से कौन सा 'नियम' जोड़ता है?
e: Nucleus ka dravyaman uske alag nucleons ke jod se thoda kam hota hai; yahi kami (mass defect) Einstein ke samikaran E = mc2 ke anusar urja mein badalti hai, jise binding energy kehte hain - isliye mass defect aur binding energy ko jodne wala niyam yahi samikaran hai. Isi karan bhaari nucleus ka tootna (fission) aur halke ka jurna (fusion) dono urja chhodte hain. Half-life ka niyam kshaya ki gati batata hai, aur Hess ka niyam rasayanik enthalpy ke liye hai - Ye vikalp galat hain. Exam point: mass defect se binding energy nikalne ka sambandh = Einstein ka mass-energy samikaran E = mc2.

qe: What is the 'Half-life' of Uranium-235?
qh: यूरेनियम-235 की 'अर्ध-आयु' क्या है?
e: Uranium-235 ki ardhaayu (half-life) lagbhag 700 million (70 crore) sal hoti hai - yani itne samay mein uski aadhi matara toot jaati hai; iska matlab hai ki ye bahut dheeme tootta hai, isliye reactor mein iski shrinkhala kriya neutron se hi chalani padti hai. U-238 ki ardhaayu 4.5 billion sal aur C-14 ki 5730 sal hoti hai, isliye wo aankde U-235 ke liye sahi nahi hain. Isi lambi ardhaayu ke karan uranium khanizon/mitti mein saloon tak bacha rehta hai. Exam point: Uranium-235 ki half-life lagbhag 700 million sal (70 crore sal) hoti hai; iske muqable U-238 (4.5 billion sal) aur bhi dheeme tootta hai.

qe: Which radioactive isotope is used to study 'Blood Circulation' and detect clots?
qh: रक्त परिसंचरण के अध्ययन और थक्कों का पता लगाने के लिए किस रेडियोधर्मी समस्थानिक का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Sodium-24 ek radioactive isotope hai jo khoon (blood) mein ghol kar diya jaata hai, aur uski gamma vaikiran se pata chalta hai ki khoon ka bahav kahan dheema ho raha hai - isliye ye khoon ke bahav (circulation), blood clots aur dilution studies mein istemal hota hai. Iodine-131 thyroid ke liye, Cobalt-60 cancer ke liye aur Carbon-14 photosynthesis/dating ke liye istemal hota hai - Ye vikalp galat hain. Isi karan ise 'tracer' (anuvehsi) kehte hain, kyunki ye shareer ke andar se signal deta hua chalta hai. Exam point: blood circulation aur khoon ke thakke (clots) jaanchne ka isotope = Sodium-24; ye bloodstream mein tracer ki tarah kaam karta hai.

qe: What is 'Nuclear Fallout'?
qh: 'परमाणु धूल' (Nuclear Fallout) क्या है?
o: Residual radioactive material after a nuclear blast
e: Nuclear fallout wo bache hue radioactive padarth hote hain jo nuclear vismarak (blast) ke baad hawa mein failte hain aur dheere-dheere zameen par baith jaate hain; inmein bahut se radioactive isotopes hote hain (jaise Iodine-131, Cesium-137, Strontium-90) jo gehre asar dete hain. Iske ulat, blast ke turant baad nikalne wali vaikiran aur garmi alag cheez hai. Yahi karan hai ki nuclear test ke baad mitti aur paani radioaktiv ho jaate hain aur kaafi salon tak asar bana rehta hai. Exam point: nuclear fallout = nuclear vismaar ke baad bache radioactive padarth (jaise Cs-137, Sr-90, I-131) jo hawa se zameen par girte hain.

qe: Which 'Subatomic Particle' is missing in a Protium nucleus?
qh: प्रोटियम नाभिक में कौन सा 'उप-परमाणु कण' अनुपस्थित होता है?
e: Protium (saadhaaran hydrogen, 1H) ke nabhik (nucleus) mein keval ek proton hota hai, isliye usme neutron nahi hota - yahi karan hai ki uske saath koi neutron 'missing' hota hai; deuterium (2H) mein ek proton + ek neutron aur tritium (3H) mein ek proton + do neutron hote hain. Isliye hydrogen ke teen samsthiti (isotopes) hote hain aur unke rasayanik gun lagbhag same hote hain par dravyaman alag hota hai. Electron, proton ya positron ke baare mein yahan prashn nahi hai. Exam point: protium (1H) ke nucleus mein neutron nahi hota (sirf 1 proton); deuterium mein 1 aur tritium mein 2 neutron hote hain.

qe: What is the 'Decay Series' of Plutonium-239?
qh: प्लूटोनियम-239 की 'क्षय श्रृंखला' क्या है?
e: Plutonium-239 ka kshaya (decay) 4n+1 series ke anusar hota hai, jise neptunium series kehte hain kyunki iske pehle member ke roop mein neptunium (Np-237 jaisa) hota hai; isi karan is series ka gati-kram anya series se alag hota hai aur iska antim sthir padarth bismuth (Bi-209) hota hai (uranium series mein sisa banta hai). Isliye Pu-239 ko 4n+1 series mein rakha jaata hai. Thorium series (4n) aur uranium-radium series (4n+2) ke liye ye sahi jod nahi hai. Exam point: Plutonium-239 ki decay series = neptunium series (4n+1), jiska antim sthir padarth bismuth (Bi-209) hota hai.

qe: Which 'Radiation' is used to change the color of gemstones (like blue Topaz)?
qh: रत्नों (जैसे नीले पुखराज) का रंग बदलने के लिए किस 'विकिरण' का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Gems (ratna) ko vaikiran (gamma rays) se bombaard karne par uske andar ke rang-kendron (colour centres) badal jaate hain, jisse rang gehra ya shuddh ho jaata hai - isliye neeli topaz, peela sapphire jaise rang khade kiye jaate hain. Yahi tarika 'radiation treatment of gems' kehlata hai, aur ismein only gamma/beta vaikiran ka istemal hota hai kyunki unki bhedan shakti adhik hoti hai. Alpha particles bahut kam door jaate hain aur X-rays ki urja kam hoti hai (rang badalne ke liye adhik urja chahiye). Exam point: gems ka rang badalne ke liye gamma rays ka istemal hota hai, kyunki ye padarth ke andar tak pahunch kar colour centres ko badal deti hain.

qe: What is 'Radiolysis'?
qh: 'रेडियोलिसिस' (Radiolysis) क्या है?
o: Decomposition of molecules by ionizing radiation
e: Radiolysis wo kriya hai jismein ionising vaikiran (jaise gamma kirnein) kisi padarth ke aanviya bandhan (molecular bonds) ko tod deti hai - jaise reactor mein paani ka radiolysis hokar hydrogen aur hydrogen peroxide banta hai, isliye reactor ke paani ka lagatar shuddhikaran karna padta hai. Isme padarth ka rasayanik tootna hi mukhya hai (nucleus nahi tootta). Photolysis prakash se aur pyrolysis garmi se hone wala tootna hai, aur radioaktiv kshaya nucleus ke andar hoti hai - isliye wo vikalp sahi jod nahi hain. Exam point: radiolysis = ionising vaikiran (gamma) se molecules ka tootna, jaise paani ka H2 aur H2O2 mein tootna (reactor mein isse bachne ke liye paani shudh kiya jaata hai).

qe: Which isotope is used in 'Carbon-11 PET Scan' for brain imaging?
qh: मस्तिष्क इमेजिंग के लिए 'कार्बन-11 PET स्कैन' में किस समस्थानिक का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: PET scan (positron emission tomography) mein Carbon-11 jaise positron chhodne wale (emitter) isotopes istemal hote hain - ye positron aur electron ke milan se gama photon deta hai, jisse dimag ke andar glucose ka upyog aur ootak (tumour) ka pata chalta hai; C-11 ki ardhaayu sirf lagbhag 20 minute hoti hai, isliye yahi chhota samay brain imaging ke liye upyukt hota hai. Fluorine-18 aaj-kal FDG ke saath zyada istemal hota hai, par carbon wale anuon ke liye C-11 chuna jaata hai. Iodine-131, Cobalt-60 ya Uranium-235 is khaas kaam ke liye istemal nahi hote. Exam point: brain imaging ke PET scan mein positron chhodne wala isotope = Carbon-11 (ardhaayu sirf ~20 minute); isse dimag ke metabolism ka pata chalta hai.

qe: What is 'Nuclear Magnetic Resonance' (NMR) primarily used for?
qh: 'परमाणु चुंबकीय अनुनाद' (NMR) का मुख्य रूप से किस लिए उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) mein nucleus par bahari chumbakiya kshetra lagakar tage (radio waves) di jaati hain aur unke pravartan (absorption) se pata chalta hai ki molecule mein kis atom ke aas-paas kaisa parivesh (chemical environment) hai - isliye ise molecules aur unke dhanchon (structure) ke adhyayan ke liye istemal karte hain. Isi principle ka bada roop MRI hai jo koshika aur ootak ki chhavi banata hai. Ismein nucleus tootta nahi (kyunki koi vaikiran nahi nikalti) - isliye 'nuclear waste', 'bijli utpadan' ya 'fission' wale vikalp iske kaam nahi hain. Exam point: NMR ka mukhya upyog = molecules aur unke dhanchon ka adhyayan (aur MRI ke roop mein chhavikaran); ye kriya nucleus ke chumbakiya gun par aadhaarit hai.

qe: Which 'Force' overcomes the electrostatic repulsion between protons in the nucleus?
qh: नाभिक में प्रोटॉन के बीच स्थिरवैद्युत प्रतिकर्षण को कौन सा 'बल' नियंत्रित करता है?
e: Nucleus ke andar proton dhanaveshit hote hain, isliye unke beech vidyut vikarshan (electrostatic repulsion) hota hai jo nucleus ko tod dega; ise rokne ke liye prabal nuclear force kaam karti hai jo proton aur neutron ke beech lagti hai aur gravitation se lagbhag 10^38 guna prabal hoti hai. Ye bal sirf bahut kam doori (10^-15 m ke aas-paas) tak kaam karta hai, isliye bade nucleus mein bahari protonon ka vikarshan badh jaata hai aur wo asthir ho jaate hain. Vidyut bal to vikarshan hi karta hai, chumbakiya bal ghatak hai aur gravitation bahut kamzor - Ye vikalp galat hain. Exam point: protonon ke vikarshan ko todne wala bal = prabal nuclear force (strong nuclear force), jo bahut kam range mein kaam karta hai par sabse prabal hai.

qe: What is the 'Half-life' of Tritium (an isotope of Hydrogen)?
qh: ट्रिटियम (हाइड्रोजन का एक समस्थानिक) की 'अर्ध-आयु' क्या है?
e: Tritium (hydrogen-3) ek radioaktiv samsthiti hai jiski ardhaayu lagbhag 12.3 sal hoti hai; yahi karan hai ki ye atomi test aur nuclear reactor ke paas ke vaatavaran mein thoda samay tak bana rehta hai. Iski isi chhoti ardhaayu ke karan ise 'tracer' aur hydrogen bomb ke liye istemal karte hain, jabki deuterium sthir hota hai. Uranium-238 ki ardhaayu 4.5 billion sal aur C-14 ki 5730 sal hoti hai, isliye wo tritium ke liye sahi jod nahi. Dhyan rakhein: tritium ka beta kshaya halka hota hai isliye uska label (marking) aam taur par paint mein istemal hota hai. Exam point: tritium ki ardhaayu lagbhag 12.3 sal hoti hai; ye beta emitter hai aur hydrogen bomb tatha tracer ke liye istemal hota hai.

qe: Which radioactive isotope is used in 'Pace-makers' for the heart?
qh: हृदय के 'पेसमेकर' में किस रेडियोधर्मी समस्थानिक का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Heart pacemaker mein saaloon tak chhota bijli-source chahiye hota tha, isliye Plutonium-238 jaise alpha-chhodne wale isotope ki garmi ko thermocouple se bijli mein badalne wali battery istemal hui - iski lambi half-life (lagbhag 87 sal) se yantra 10 sal se adhik chalta tha. Ye kaam Cobalt-60 (gama, cancer ke liye), Iodine-131 (thyroid) ya C-14 (dating) se nahi hota, kyunki unki urja-mukti kam ya unki half-life chhoti hoti hai. Aaj lithium battery wale pacemaker aam hain, par vigyaan-itihas ke anusaar Pu-238 hi is prashn ka sahi jod hai. Exam point: pacemaker ke liye Plutonium-238 (thermoelectric battery) chuna jaata tha, kyunki iski lambi ardhaayu se chhota yantra saaloon tak chalta hai.

qe: What is 'Nuclear Cross-section' measured in?
qh: 'परमाणु क्रॉस-सेक्शन' (Nuclear Cross-section) किसमें मापा जाता है?
e: Nuclear cross-section ko 'barn' ikai mein maapa jaata hai, jahan 1 barn = 10^-28 square metre hota hai - ye basically ek aisi 'prabhavi chhaya' (effective target area) batata hai jismein neutron nucleus se takraata hai. Bharat-Neutrino observatory jaisi labon mein ise hi istemal karte hain. Ise area ki ikai mein maapa jaata hai, isliye Newton (bal), Pascal (dabav) aur Meter (lambai) yahan sahi nahi hain. Yahi karan hai ki reactor ke 'neutron economy' ke ganit mein barn ka bahut mahatva hai. Exam point: nuclear cross-section ki ikai = barn (1 barn = 10^-28 m2); ye nucleus ki neutron grahan karne ki prabhavi chhaya batata hai.

qe: Which type of 'Nuclear Reaction' occurs in a Hydrogen Bomb?
qh: हाइड्रोजन बम में किस प्रकार की 'परमाणु अभिक्रिया' होती है?
e: Hydrogen bomb mein fusion ki kriya hone ke liye pehle ek atomic (fission) vismarak (trigger) se atyadhik garmi paida ki jaati hai, aur uske baad deuterium-tritium ka sanlagan (fusion) abhi-asanrakshit (uncontrolled) roop se hota hai - isliye hydrogen bomb ki shakti kai megaton tak pahunch jaati hai. Iske ulat reactor mein chain reaction niyantrit hoti hai aur koi vismarak urja-mukti nahi hoti. Chemical jalna, radioaktiv tootna ya nuclear fission akele hydrogen bomb ka aadhaar nahi hain (fission sirf trigger ka kaam karta hai). Exam point: hydrogen bomb = uncontrolled nuclear fusion (deuterium + tritium se helium banata hai), jise fission trigger se shuru kiya jaata hai.

qe: What is 'K-capture' in radioactivity?
qh: रेडियोधर्मिता में 'K-कैप्चर' क्या है?
o: Absorption of K-shell electron by nucleus
e: K-capture (ya EC, electron capture) mein nucleus apni hi K-kaksha (innermost shell) ka ek electron kheench leta hai aur ushe proton ke saath milakar neutron bana deta hai - isliye atomic number 1 kam ho jaata hai par mass number wahi rehta hai, aur K-shell ki khaali jagah ko bharne se khaas X-ray nikalti hai (ise atomic number ka pata lagane ke liye istemal karte hain). Yahi kriya positron emission ka vikalp hai. Kaka-kaksha se bahari electron ka nikalna (photo-ionisation) ya nucleus se alpha nikalna alag kriyaayein hain, Ye vikalp galat hain. Exam point: K-capture = nucleus dwara andar wale (K) shell ka electron sokh lena, jisse atomic number 1 ghatta hai; isme electron nikalta nahi, andar jaata hai.

qe: Which 'Shielding Material' is best for blocking Neutron radiation?
qh: न्यूट्रॉन विकिरण को रोकने के लिए सबसे अच्छा 'परिरक्षण पदार्थ' क्या है?
e: Neutron ka aavesh shunya hota hai, isliye wo bhaari nuclei (sisa ya loha) ke electron bhag se aaram se guzar jaata hai; neutron ko rokne ke liye bahut halke nuclei - hydrogen - wale padarth istemal hote hain, kyunki neutron ki urja paani ya paraffin (hydrocarbon) ke hydrogen se takra kar nikal jaati hai. Isi karan reactor ke aas-paas paani, paraffin ya concrete rakhi jaati hai. Sisa neutron ke liye kam asar karta hai (uska istemal gamma aur X-ray rokne ke liye hota hai), isliye 'lead sheet' wala vikalp neutron shield ke liye theek nahi. Exam point: neutron vaikiran rokne ke liye hydrogen-yukt padarth (paani, paraffin, concrete) sabse upyukt hain, kyunki neutron halke nucleus se takra kar urja khota hai.

qe: What is the 'Activity' of a radioactive sample?
qh: एक रेडियोधर्मी नमूने की 'सक्रियता' क्या है?
e: Kisi radioaktiv namune ki 'activity' batati hai ki ek second mein kitne nabhik (nuclei) tootta hain, yani kshaya (disintegrations) prati samay - isliye iski ikai bequerel (1 decay/second) ya curie (3.7 x 10^10 decay/second) hoti hai. Activity shuruaati matara par nirbhar karti hai aur samay ke saath ghatti jaati hai (activity proportional to number of atoms bache hain). Isliye 'kucha matra', 'dravyaman' ya 'aavesh' activity ki paribhasha nahi hain. Exam point: activity = prati samay kshaya (decay) ki sankhya (Bq ya Ci mein); ye bache hue atomon ki sankhya ke samanupati hoti hai aur samay ke saath ghatti hai.

qe: Which particle is identical to a 'Beta-minus' particle?
qh: कौन सा कण 'बीटा-माइनस' कण के समान है?
e: Beta-minus kshaya mein ek negatron nikalta hai jiska dravyaman electron ke barabar (lagbhag 9.1 x 10^-31 kg) aur aavesh -1 hota hai; isliye use electron hi kaha jaata hai. Positron electron ka ulta (aavesh +1) hota hai, proton bhaari hota hai aur neutron niraveshi hota hai - isliye inmein se koi bhi beta-minus nahi hai. Yaad rakhein ki beta kan nucleus ke andar se nikalta hai par wo pehle se wahin nahi hota, wo neutron ke tootne par paida hota hai. Exam point: beta-minus particle ek electron hai (aavesh -1); iska poshan positron (aavesh +1) beta-plus kshaya mein nikalta hai.

qe: What is 'Nuclear Waste' primarily stored in for long-term disposal?
qh: दीर्घकालिक निपटान के लिए 'परमाणु कचरे' को मुख्य रूप से किसमें संग्रहित किया जाता है?
e: Used nuclear fuel se banti high-level nuclear waste ko pehle saalon tak paani ke pool mein thanda kiya jaata hai aur phir use kaanch (glass) mein milakar 'vitrification' kiya jaata hai aur steel ke mazbut canisters mein bandh kar gehri chatton (deep geological) mein dabaya jaata hai - aisa isliye kiya jaata hai ki kuchh isotopes hazaron sal tak khatarnak rehte hain. Plastic bags, lakdi ke dabbe ya khuli jagah rakhna suraksha ke saath hi asambhav hai. Isi karan nuclear waste ki surakshit nikaasi vigyaan aur rajniti ka bada sawal ban jaata hai. Exam point: high-level nuclear waste ko vitrified glass mein milakar steel canisters mein bandha jaata hai aur gehri chatton mein rakha jaata hai (plastic ya lakdi ke dabbe ka istemal nahi hota).

qe: Which radioactive isotope is used to determine the age of 'Ancient Paintings' or Manuscripts?
qh: 'प्राचीन चित्रों' या पांडुलिपियों की आयु निर्धारित करने के लिए किस रेडियोधर्मी समस्थानिक का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Purani chitrakari aur hastalikhit (manuscript) ki sayahi aur unke aadhaar (parchment, canvas) jaivik (organic) padarth se bante hain, isliye unmein bacha hua Carbon-14 dekh kar umar nikali jaati hai - C-14 ki lambi ardhaayu (5730 sal) is kaam ke liye upyukt hoti hai. Isi tarika 'radiocarbon dating' kehlata hai aur 50,000 sal tak purane namuno ki umar batata hai. Uranium-lead dating chattanon ke liye, Potassium-argon jwalamukhi padarthon ke liye aur Thorium-230 samudri padarthon ke liye hoti hai - Ye vikalp galat hain. Exam point: chitrakari aur purane hastalikhat ki umar = Carbon-14 (5730 sal half-life) wali radiocarbon dating, kyunki inka aadhaar jaivik padarth hota hai.

qe: What is the 'Half-life' of Radium-226 approximately?
qh: रेडियम-226 की अनुमानित 'अर्ध-आयु' क्या है?
e: Radium-226 (Ra-226) ki ardhaayu lagbhag 1600 sal hoti hai, isliye ye uranium-238 ke kshaya series ka beech ka member hua karta hai aur purane khanizon mein saloon tak bacha rehta hai. Aaj bhi ise hospital mein purane brachytherapy ke liye aur school-laboratory ke pradarshan ke liye yaad kiya jaata hai (par iski suraksha bahut zaroori hai). C-14 ki ardhaayu 5730 sal, U-238 ki 4.5 billion sal aur Cobalt-60 ki lagbhag 5.3 sal hoti hai, isliye wo aankde Ra-226 ke liye sahi nahi hain. Exam point: Radium-226 ki ardh-aayu lagbhag 1600 sal hoti hai; ye U-238 ke kshaya (decay) series mein banta hai aur alpha emitter hai.

qe: Which particle has 'Zero' mass and 'Zero' charge?
qh: किस कण का द्रव्यमान 'शून्य' और आवेश 'शून्य' होता है?
e: Neutrino ek aisa mul-kan (subtomic particle) hai jiska aavesh shunya hai aur dravyaman lagbhag shunya (bahut hi kam) hota hai - yahi karan hai ki wo padarth ke aar-paar bina rukawat chala jaata hai (crore neutrinos har second hamare shareer se guzarte hain par pata nahi chalta). Beta kshaya mein isi liye neutrino (ya anti-neutrino) bhi nikalta hai, aur iske aavesh aur dravyaman shunya hone se urja aur samveg (momentum) ka hisaab poora hota hai. Electron, proton aur neutron sab ka dravyaman hota hai, isliye wo sahi jod nahi hain. Exam point: neutrino ka aavesh aur dravyaman dono lagbhag shunya hote hain; yahi karan hai ki wo padarth se aaram se guzar jaata hai (beta kshaya mein nikalta hai).

qe: What is 'Nuclear Chain Reaction' multiplication factor (k) for stability?
qh: स्थिरता के लिए परमाणु श्रृंखला अभिक्रिया का 'गुणन कारक' (k) क्या होना चाहिए?
e: Nuclear shrinkhala (chain) kriya mein multiplication factor k batata hai ki ek neutron se agle pad mein kitne naye neutron kriya karne ko milte hain; agar k = 1 ho to har ek neutron ke badle theek ek neutron aage badhta hai, isliye kriya ek hi gati se chalti rehti hai (ye 'critical' avastha hai, jaise reactor mein). k < 1 hone par kriya dheemi padkar ruk jaati hai aur k > 1 hone par kriya tez hoti jaati hai aur visfot (explosion) ho sakta hai; k = 0 ka matlab kriya hi nahi chalti. Exam point: stability (critical avastha) ke liye multiplication factor k = 1 hona chahiye; k < 1 kshayi (subcritical) aur k > 1 vismaraki (supercritical) avastha hai.

qe: Which radioactive element is extracted from 'Pitchblende' ore?
qh: 'पिचब्लेंड' अयस्क से कौन सा रेडियोधर्मी तत्व निकाला जाता है?
e: Pitchblende (uraninite) ek khaniz hai jismein uranium ke saath radium bhi milta hai - Marie aur Pierre Curie ne isi khaniz se radium aur polonium alag kiye the, aur U-238 ke tootne se hi radium paida hota hai. Isliye is ore se uranium aur radium dono nikalte hain. Thorium praaya: mukhya roop se monazite se nikalta hai, isliye pitchblende ka seedha sambandh thorium se nahi hota. Exam point: pitchblende ore se uranium aur radium dono milte hain (Curie dmpati ne isi ore se radium alag kiya tha); thorium monazite sand se nikalta hai.

qe: What is 'Artificial Transmutation'?
qh: 'कृत्रिम तत्वान्तरण' (Artificial Transmutation) क्या है?
o: Changing one element into another by bombardment
e: Artificial transmutation ka matlab hai ki kisi ek tatva (element) ko kan (particle) se bombaard karke doosre tatva mein badal dena - jaise Rutherford ne nitrogen par alpha particles daal kar wahi pehla artificial transmutation dikhaya (N-14 se O-17 + proton). Ye kriya natural radioactive tootne se alag hai kyunki isme naya element insaan ke prayog se banta hai. Iske ulat, aaynik bandhan (ionic bond), sanyojan (compound) banana ya isotope ka tootna transmutation nahi hote. Exam point: artificial transmutation = kan (alpha, proton, neutron) se bombaard karke ek tatva ko doosre tatva mein badalna (Rutherford ka N-14 par alpha) - yahi artificial radioactivity ka bhi aadhaar bana.

qe: Which rays are 'Electromagnetic' in nature?
qh: कौन सी किरणें प्रकृति में 'विद्युत चुंबकीय' होती हैं?
e: Gama kirnein vidyut-chumbakiya (electromagnetic) tarangein hoti hain - inka swabhav prakash jaisa hota hai (photon), isliye inpar vidyut aur chumbakiya kshetra ka koi asar nahi hota. Alpha kirnein helium nucleus (kan) hain aur beta kirnein electron (kan) hain, isliye ye dono padarth ke kan hai, tarangein nahi; cathode kirnein electron ki dhara hoti hain. Isi karan gama ki speed prakash ki speed ke barabar hoti hai aur ye sabase zyada bhedan-shakti rakhti hain. Exam point: electromagnetic swabhav wali kirnein = gamma rays (photon); alpha aur beta kan (particles) hain aur cathode rays electron ki dhara hain.

qe: What is the 'Charge' on a Beta-plus particle (Positron)?
qh: बीटा-प्लस कण (पॉजिट्रॉन) पर 'आवेश' क्या होता है?
e: Positron (beta-plus) electron ka poshan (anti-particle) hai; usme electron jitna hi dravyaman hota hai par aavesh +1 hota hai (electron ka aavesh -1 hota hai). Beta-plus kshaya mein nucleus ka proton neutron mein badalta hai aur positron bahar nikalta hai, jisme atomic number 1 ghat jaata hai. Alpha (+2), gamma (0) aur neutron (0) - in teeno ka aavesh is maap mein nahi baithta, Ye vikalp galat hain. Dhyan rakhein: positron electron se takra kar unhi vishleshan (annihilation) kar deta hai aur do gama photons banti hain (isi par PET scan kaam karta hai). Exam point: positron (beta-plus) ka aavesh = +1 (dravyaman electron jitna); iske aur electron ke milan se do gama photon banti hain (annihilation).

qe: Which country is the largest producer of 'Thorium' in the world?
qh: विश्व में 'थोरियम' का सबसे बड़ा उत्पादक देश कौन सा है?
e: Bharat duniya mein thorium ka sabse bada bhandar (reserve) rakhne wala desh hai - Kerala, Odisha aur Tamil Nadu ki samudri ret (monazite) mein thorium ki matara bahut adhik hai, isliye Bharat apne teen-pad (three stage) nuclear programme mein thorium ko bhavishya ke indhan ke roop mein dekhta hai. Isi karan thorium aadhaarit (based) reactor ka vikas Bharat ki lambi yojna hai. Australia aur Kazakhstan uranium mein aage hain, par thorium ke bhandar mein Bharat sabse aage hai. Exam point: thorium ka sabse bada bhandar (reserve/producer) wala desh = Bharat (samudri monazite ret se); isliye Bharat ka teen-pad nuclear programme thorium par kendrit hai.

qe: What is 'Nuclear Winter'?
qh: 'परमाणु शीतकाल' (Nuclear Winter) क्या है?
o: Global cooling caused by nuclear war smoke
e: Nuclear winter ek aise vaigyanik anuman (prediction) ka naam hai jismein bade pramaan ke nuclear yuddh ke baad aakash mein dhool, dhuaan aur soot (aerosol) itna phail jaayega ki suraj ki roshni zameen tak nahi pahunchegi - isliye duniya bhar ka tapman kaafi gir jaayega, fasal kharab hogi aur bhukhmari ka khatra bane ga. Yahi karan hai ki nuclear yuddh ka asar sirf vismarak vivaron tak nahi, poori jalvaayu par padta hai. Iske ulat radiation ka seedha asar, blast ya garmi alag cheez hai. Exam point: nuclear winter = nuclear yuddh ke baad soot se suraj ki roshni rukne par duniya bhar mein tapman ka girna (global cooling) aur fasalon ka nasht hona.

qe: What is the 'Mass-Energy Equivalence' equation proposed by Einstein?
qh: आइंस्टीन द्वारा प्रस्तावित 'द्रव्यमान-ऊर्जा तुल्यता' समीकरण क्या है?
e: Einstein ka samikaran E = mc2 dravyaman aur urja ki samaanata (equivalence) batata hai - yani dravyaman urja ka hi ek roop hai; isliye agar dravyaman mein thoda bhi badlav ho to bahut badi urja milti hai (c = 3 x 10^8 m/s ke varg ke karan). Isi samikaran se nuclear fission aur fusion mein nikalne wali urja aur mass defect ka ganit hota hai. E = mv, E = mc ya E = mc2/2 jaise roop ganit ke hisaab se sahi nahi hain (E = mv to samveg ka hai). Exam point: mass-energy equivalence ka samikaran E = mc2 hai; isi se nuclear viyojan (fission) aur sanlagan (fusion) mein nikalne wali urja nikalti hai.

qe: Which radioactive series starts with Thorium-232 and ends with Lead-208?
qh: कौन सी रेडियोधर्मी श्रृंखला थोरियम-232 से शुरू होती है और लेड-208 पर समाप्त होती है?
e: Thorium-232 se shuru hone wali kshaya shrinkhala ka har member 4n ke roop mein likha ja sakta hai (232 = 4 x 58), isliye ye 4n series kehlati hai, aur iska antim sthir padarth lead-208 hota hai. Isi karan thorium series ko '4n series' bhi kehte hain (uranium-radium series 4n+2 aur neptunium series 4n+1 hoti hai). 4n+1 ya 4n+2 wale vikalp anya series ke hain, isliye wo yahan sahi nahi. Exam point: Thorium-232 se shuru hokar Lead-208 par khatam hone wali series = 4n series (thorium series), kyunki har pad ka mass number 4 ka gunaank hota hai.

qe: What is the 'Radioactive Displacement Law' (Soddy-Fajans Law) regarding Alpha decay?
qh: अल्फा क्षय के संबंध में 'रेडियोधर्मी विस्थापन नियम' क्या है?
e: Radioactive displacement law (Soddy-Fajans) kehti hai ki kshaya ke baad naya element periodic table ki kis jagah pahunchta hai - alpha kshaya mein do proton aur do neutron nikalne se atomic number 2 kam ho jaata hai, isliye element do sthaan peeche chala jaata hai (mass number 4 kam). Isi niyam se ye bhi nikalta hai ki beta kshaya mein element ek sthaan aage badh jaata hai. 'Ek sthaan peeche', 'do sthaan aage' ya 'koi badlav nahi' wale kathan is niyam ke virudh hain. Exam point: Soddy-Fajans law ke hisaab se alpha kshaya mein element do sthaan peeche khisakta hai (Z mein 2 ki kami, A mein 4 ki kami).

qe: What is the 'Nuclear Force' characteristic?
qh: 'नाभिकीय बल' की विशेषता क्या है?
e: Nuclear force ki do khaas baatein hain - ye bahut prabal hoti hai (vidyut bal se lagbhag 100 guna) par iski range atyant kam (lagbhag 10^-15 m yani nucleus ke aakaar jitni) hoti hai; is range ke bahar ye khatam ho jaati hai. Isi karan bahut bade nucleus par bahari protonon ka vidyut vikarshan prabhavi ho jaata hai aur wo asthir ho jaate hain (isse alpha kshaya hoti hai). 'Lambi range', 'sirf electronon par kaam' ya 'gravitation se bhi kamzor' wale vikalp nuclear force ke gun nahi hain. Exam point: nuclear force bahut prabal (strongest) hoti hai par short range (bahut kam doori tak hi) kaam karti hai; isliye bade nucleus asthir hote hain.

qe: Which isotope is used to detect 'Leaks' in underground oil or water pipes?
qh: भूमिगत तेल या पानी के पाइपों में 'रिसाव' का पता लगाने के लिए किस समस्थानिक का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Bhoomigat tel ya paani ki pipe mein leak dhoondhne ke liye Sodium-24 ko pipe ke pravaah ke saath chhoda jaata hai aur uski gama vaikiran ko zameen par upar se maapa jaata hai - jahan vaikiran zyada mile, wahan leak hai; kyunki pipe ke andar se bahar nikalne wali matara ki khaas jagah yahi batati hai. Isi tarah ise 'tracer' (anuvehsi) kehte hain, jaise khoon ke bahav ke liye bhi ye istemal hota hai. Uranium-235 indhan ke liye aur Cobalt-60 cancer ke liye hota hai, Ye vikalp galat hain. Exam point: bhoomigat pipe/tel leak dhoondhne ke liye Sodium-24 ka istemal hota hai (tracer ke roop mein, gama vaikiran se leak ki jagah ka pata chalta hai).

qe: What is the 'Packing Fraction' of a nucleus?
qh: नाभिक का 'पैकिंग अंश' (Packing Fraction) क्या है?
e: Packing fraction (dravyaman-kami ka gunaank) batata hai ki nucleus ke andar nucleons ke jod ki tulna mein kitna dravyaman kami (mass defect) hai, ushe prati nucleon (per nucleon) ke roop mein vyakt kiya jaata hai - isliye ye nucleus ki sthirta ka maap hai. Jab packing fraction ka maan shunya ke paas (ya rin) hota hai, nucleus sabse zyada sthir hota hai (jaise iron). Isliye 'volume/mass', 'total mass' ya 'aayatan ka aadha' aise aankde iski paribhasha nahi hain. Exam point: packing fraction = mass defect per nucleon; ye batata hai ki nucleus kitna sthir hai (iron jaise madhyam bhaar wale nabhik sabse sthir hote hain).

qe: Which radiation is 'Deflected' most by a magnetic field?
qh: चुंबकीय क्षेत्र द्वारा कौन सा विकिरण सबसे अधिक 'विक्षेपित' होता है?
e: Chumbakiya kshetra mein sabse zyada mudne wala kan beta particle hota hai, kyunki beta ka dravyaman bahut kam (electron jitna) hota hai par aavesh ek hota hai - halka hone ke karan wo tez mudta hai. Alpha bhaari hota hai isliye kam mudta hai, aur gamma udasin (neutral) hone ke karan bilkul nahi mudta. Isi gun se beta aur alpha kirnon ko alag pehchana jaata hai aur unke aavesh-dravyaman ka anuman lagaya jaata hai. Exam point: chumbakiya kshetra mein sabse zyada mudne wala vaikiran = beta particle (halka aur aavesh-yukt); gamma bilkul nahi mudti (neutral), alpha sabse kam.

qe: What is 'Nuclear Isomer' of an element?
qh: किसी तत्व का 'परमाणु समावयवी' क्या है?
o: Same A and Z, different life
e: Nuclear isomer aise do nabhik hote hain jinke atomic number (Z) aur mass number (A) dono ek jaise hote hain (yani ek hi element ke samsthiti), par unke andar ki urja avastha alag hoti hai, isliye unki sthirta aur 'jivan-kaal' (life/half-life) alag dikhti hai - jaise technetium-99m metastable isomer hai jise medical imaging mein istemal karte hain. Isliye 'same A aur Z par alag jivan-kaal' wala jod sahi hai. Same dravyaman par alag neutron (wo isotope kahalata hai), different A aur Z (wo do alag element) - ye isomer ki paribhasha nahi hain. Exam point: nuclear isomers = ek hi A aur Z par alag- alag urja avastha aur alag half-life (jaise Tc-99m, jo medical scan mein istemal hota hai).

qe: Which 'Coolant' is used in fast breeder reactors?
qh: फास्ट ब्रीडर रिएक्टरों में किस 'शीतलक' का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Fast breeder reactors mein shitalak (coolant) ke roop mein drav (liquid) sodium istemal hota hai, kyunki drav sodium ki uchch tap-chaalakta aur kam absorptivity ke karan ye nuclear reactor ke core se bahut garmi tezi se le jaata hai aur high tapman par bhi drav rehta hai. Paani coolant ke roop mein breeder ke liye nahi hota kyunki wo neutron ko dheema kar deta hai. Isi liye Bharat ke PFBR (Prototype Fast Breeder Reactor, Kalpakkam) mein liquid sodium coolant rakha gaya hai. Lead-bismuth jaisi anya dhaatuen bhi istemal hoti hain par mukhya udaharan sodium hai. Exam point: fast breeder reactor ka coolant = drav sodium (liquid sodium) - kyunki ye garmi bahut tez le jaata hai aur neutron ko dheema nahi karta.

qe: What is 'Electron Capture' in nuclear chemistry?
qh: नाभिकीय रसायन में 'इलेक्ट्रॉन कैप्चर' क्या है?
o: Nucleus absorbs an inner shell electron
e: Electron capture mein nucleus apne hi andar ki kaksha (K ya L) se ek electron kheench leta hai; wo electron ek proton ke saath mil kar neutron bana deta hai, isliye naya element periodic table mein ek sthaan peeche chala jaata hai (atomic number 1 kam) aur mass number nahi badalta. Khaali hui kaksha bharne ke samay khaas X-ray nikalti hai, isliye X-ray detector se electron capture pehchana jaata hai. Positron emission iska doosra roop hai jisme antimatter kan bahar jaata hai, aur beta kshaya mein electron bahar nikalta hai - isliye wo ulti kriyaon ke vikalp hain. Exam point: electron capture mein andar ka electron nucleus mein chala jaata hai, proton se neutron banta hai, atomic number 1 ghatta hai aur khaas X-ray nikalti hai.

qe: What is the charge on a 'Gamma' ray photon?
qh: गामा किरण फोटॉन पर कितना आवेश होता है?
e: Gama kirnein vidyut-chumbakiya tarang (photon) hoti hain, isliye unpar koi vidyut aavesh nahi hota - yani unka aavesh shunya hai (aur dravyaman bhi shunya). Isi karan gama kirnein vidyut aur chumbakiya kshetra se nahi mudti aur padarth ke aar-paar gehre tak chali jaati hain. Alpha (+2) aur beta (-1) par aavesh hota hai, isliye wo sahi jod nahi hain; gama ka aavesh -1 ya +1 bilkul nahi ho sakta. Exam point: gama photon ka aavesh aur dravyaman dono zero hote hain; isliye ye vidyut-chumbakiya kshetra mein nahi mudti aur sabse adhik bhedan-shakti rakhti hai.

qe: Which isotope of Carbon is used in Carbon Dating?
qh: कार्बन डेटिंग में कार्बन के किस समस्थानिक का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Carbon-14 (C-14) ka upyog carbon dating mein hota hai kyunki ye vaayumandal mein banta hai aur saare jeevon ke shareer mein carbon ke roop mein jama rehta hai; mrityu ke baad ye ghatta jaata hai (ardhaayu 5730 sal) - isliye bachi hui matara se umar nikali jaati hai. Doosra udaharan: lakdi, haddi, kagaz, aata aur purani chitrakari. C-12 sthir hota hai aur C-11 ki ardhaayu sirf 20 minute hoti hai, isliye wo dating ke liye upyukt nahi hain, aur C-13 bhi sthir isotope hai. Exam point: carbon dating ke liye Carbon-14 hi istemal hota hai (ardhaayu 5730 sal); C-12 aur C-13 sthir isotopes hain aur C-11 bahut chhote jivan wala.

qe: Which type of radiation is most dangerous when 'Ingested' (swallowed)?
qh: कौन सा विकिरण 'निगलने' पर सबसे खतरनाक होता है?
e: Nigla (ingested) ya saans ke rasate shareer mein jaane par alpha vaikiran sakhtam se khatarnak hoti hai, kyunki uski ionising shakti sabse zyada hoti hai (sabse zyada urnaja chhodti hai) aur shareer ke koshik ke andar wo bahut kam doori mein poori urja chhod deti hai - isliye andar ki koshikaon aur DNA ko gehra nukhsan pahunchati hai. Bahar se aane wale alpha ko kapde ya twacha ki bahari parat rok deti hai, par andar pahunchne par ye bahut asar karti hai (jaise radon gas se alpha). Beta aur gama ki ionising shakti kam hoti hai, isliye wo sahi jod nahi hain. Exam point: nigla (ingested) hone par sabse khatarnak = alpha vaikiran, kyunki uski ionising shakti sabse zyada hai aur wo shareer ke andar hi urja chhod deta hai.

qe: Who is known as the 'Father of Nuclear Chemistry'?
qh: 'नाभिकीय रसायन का जनक' किसे कहा जाता है?
e: Otto Hahn ko 'Father of Nuclear Chemistry' kaha jaata hai kyunki unhone (Lise Meitner ke saath) uranium ke neutron bombaard se banne wale padarthon mein barium ki khoj ki, jisse nuclear fission ki vyakhya ka raasta khula - isi khoj par unhe 1944 ka Nobel puraskar mila. Rutherford ne nucleus khoja, Marie Curie ne radium-polonium, aur Enrico Fermi ne neutron-utprerit kriyaon ka kaam kiya. Isliye 'nuclear chemistry ke janak' ki upadhi Otto Hahn ko hi milti hai. Exam point: Father of Nuclear Chemistry = Otto Hahn (nuclear fission ki khoj ke liye 1944 Nobel); Rutherford ko 'father of nuclear physics' kaha jaata hai.

qe: What is the function of 'Control Rods' in a nuclear reactor?
qh: परमाणु रिएक्टर में 'नियंत्रण छड़ों' का कार्य क्या है?
e: Bhatti mein niyantran chhad (control rods) ka kaam ho gaya neutron ko sokh (absorb) lena hai, jisse shrinkhala kriya ki gati kam ho jaaye aur reactor ek sthir (critical) avastha par chale; agar kriya tez ho jaaye to ye chhad andar aur gehre daali jaati hain. Isi liye inhe cadmium ya boron jaise neutron sokhne wale padarthon se banate hain. Ye chhad indhan nahi hoti (indhan uranium/plutonium hai), na ye neutron dheema karti hain (wo moderator ka kaam hai) aur na vaikiran rokne ka kaam karti hain (wo shield karta hai). Exam point: control rods ka kaam = atirikt (excess) neutron ko sokhkar chain reaction ki gati niyantrit karna (cadmium ya boron se bani hoti hain).

qe: What is the 'SI Unit' of radioactivity?
qh: रेडियोधर्मिता की 'SI इकाई' क्या है?
e: Aaj-kal activity ki SI ikai bequerel (Bq) hi hai, jise ek kshaya (decay) per second ke roop mein paribhashit kiya gaya hai - iska naam radioaktivta ke khoj-karta ke naam par pada. Curie purani ikai hai (1 Ci = 3.7 x 10^10 Bq) aur roentgen exposure ka maap hota hai; gray absorbed dose ka maap hai, isliye wo activity ki ikai nahi hoti. Chunki SI ikai bequerel hai, isliye is prashn mein bequerel hi sahi jod hai. Exam point: activity ki SI ikai = bequerel (Bq = 1 decay/second); curie purani ikai hai aur gray dose ka maap hai.

qe: What remains constant during 'Gamma' emission?
qh: 'गामा' उत्सर्जन के दौरान क्या स्थिर रहता है?
e: Gama emission mein nucleus ke andar ki urja photon ke roop mein bahar nikal jaati hai, par usme koi kan (proton ya neutron) nahi nikalta - isliye element nahi badalta aur atomic number tatha mass number dono sthir rehte hain (dravyaman aur aavesh ka santulan bana rehta hai). Is prashn mein diye gaye jodon mein se atomic number aur energy wala jod sahi chuna gaya hai; par dhyan rakhein ki vigyaan ki drishti se gamma emission ke baad mass number aur atomic number hi nahi badalte (sirf nucleus ki urja ghatti hai), isliye is prashn ko uttar-pustika ke anusaar padhen. Exam point: gamma emission se element (atomic number) nahi badalta; isliye yahi kathan sahi mana jaata hai ki gamma vaikiran se atomic number aur padarth same rehta hai.

qe: Which radioactive isotope is used to determine the age of 'Rocks'?
qh: 'चट्टानों' की आयु निर्धारित करने के लिए किस रेडियोधर्मी समस्थानिक का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Chattanon ki umar batane ke liye Uranium-238 istemal hota hai kyunki iski ardhaayu bahut lambi (4.5 billion sal) hoti hai aur chatton ke khanizon mein bana rehta hai; Uranium ke Lead-206 mein badalne ki matara dekh kar chatton ki umar nikali jaati hai - isi vidhi ko 'uranium-lead dating' kehte hain. C-14 sirf 50,000 sal tak ke jaivik padarthon ke liye upyukt hai aur Potassium-40 jwalamukhi (volcanic) chatton ke liye istemal hota hai, Ye vikalp galat hain. Exam point: chatton (rocks) ki umar ke liye Uranium-238 ka istemal hota hai (U-238 se Lead-206 banne ka anupat), kyunki iski ardhaayu 4.5 billion sal hai.

qe: The 'Binding Energy' per nucleon is highest for which element?
qh: प्रति न्यूक्लियॉन 'बंधन ऊर्जा' किस तत्व के लिए उच्चतम है?
e: Binding energy per nucleon (prati nucleon bandhan-urja) iron (Fe-56) ke liye sabse adhik hoti hai - isliye iron sabse sthir nucleus maana jaata hai aur halke nuclei ke sanlagan (fusion) tatha bhaari nuclei ke viyojan (fission) se iron ki taraf haasal (movement) hone par urja milti hai. Isi karan tarah-tarah ke taare iron tak pahunch kar apni urja utpadan ki yatra ruk jaati hai aur bhaari tattv supernova visfot se bante hain. Uranium, helium aur hydrogen ke liye per-nucleon binding energy iron se kam hoti hai, isliye wo sahi jod nahi hain. Exam point: binding energy per nucleon sabse adhik = iron (Fe-56); isliye iron sabse sthir nucleus hai aur uske paas jaane par fission aur fusion dono urja dete hain.

qe: What is 'Nuclear Fusion' source of energy in stars?
qh: तारों में 'परमाणु संलयन' ऊर्जा का स्रोत क्या है?
e: Taaron (jaise Surya) mein urja ka mukhya srot hydrogen ka helium mein sanlagan (fusion) hota hai - ismein proton-proton (aur bade taaron mein CNO) chakra chalta hai aur har second lagbhag 60 crore ton hydrogen helium mein badal jaata hai; isi se aseem urja aur roshni nikalti hai. Fission bhaari nucleus tootne ki kriya hai jo taaron ka mukhya srot nahi hoti, aur jalna (chemical combustion) itni lambi avadhi tak urja nahi de sakta. Isliye 'hydrogen to helium' wala jod sahi hai. Exam point: taaron aur Surya ki urja ka srot = hydrogen ka helium mein nuclear fusion; ismein 4 hydrogen nuclei se 1 helium nucleus banta hai aur urja milti hai.

qe: Which particle is emitted when a Neutron turns into a Proton in the nucleus?
qh: जब नाभिक में एक न्यूट्रॉन प्रोटॉन में बदलता है तो कौन सा कण उत्सर्जित होता है?
e: Ek neutron ke ek proton mein badalne par do cheezein hoti hain - naya proton nucleus mein hi rehta hai aur ek beta-minus kan (electron) tatha ek anti-neutrino bahar nikal jaate hain. Kyunki ek nukleon ke badle ek nukleon bana, mass number (A) nahi badalta, par proton badhne se atomic number (Z) ek badh jaata hai. Alpha kan yahan nahi nikalta (wo alpha kshaya hai) aur positron tab nikalta hai jab proton neutron bane, isliye wo vikalp ulti kriyaon ke hain. Exam point: neutron se proton banne par beta-minus (electron) nikalta hai aur atomic number 1 badhta hai; mass number nahi badalta.

qe: What is 'Heavy Water' (D2O) used for in nuclear reactors?
qh: परमाणु रिएक्टरों में 'भारी जल' का उपयोग किस लिए किया जाता है?
e: Bhaari paani (D2O) mein deuterium hota hai jo tez neutron se takra kar unhe bahut dheema kar deta hai, aur khud neutron ko na ke barabar sokhta hai - isliye isse reactor mein chain reaction kaayam rakhne wala saadhan (moderator) banaya jaata hai, aur yahi core ki garmi bhi bahar le jaata hai (coolant). Saadhaaran paani neutron sokh leta hai isliye uske liye samvardhit uranium chahiye; graphite bhi moderator hota hai par wo alag reactor ka hissa hai. Ismein indhan nahi hota, isliye indhan ya control-rod wale jod sahi nahi. Exam point: bhaari paani ka kaam reactor mein neutron ko dheema karna (moderator, aur coolant bhi) hai - isliye PHWR isi se chalte hain.

qe: Which radiation is used for 'Food Preservation' (Sterilization)?
qh: 'खाद्य संरक्षण' के लिए किस विकिरण का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Bhuna hua khana lambe samay tak kharab nahi hota kyunki gama kirnein pack ke andar tak jaakar jeevanu, keet aur unke ande ka DNA tod deti hain; ismein padarth garam nahi hota aur koi rasayanik avshesh bhi nahi bachta. Alpha aur beta kan mohar (packing) ke aar-paar nahi ja sakte, isliye gehri jagah tak pahunchne wali gama hi is kaam ke liye chuni jaati hai (jaise aalu, pyaz, masalon ki irradiation). X-ray ka istemal bhi kam hota hai kyunki unki bhedan shakti gama se kam hoti hai. Exam point: khane-padarthon ke preservation ke liye gama kirnein istemal hoti hain, jo jeevanu ko nasht karke padarth ko bina garam kiye bachati hain.

qe: What is the approximate 'Half-life' of Carbon-14?
qh: कार्बन-14 की अनुमानित 'अर्ध-आयु' क्या है?
e: Carbon-14 ki ardhaayu lagbhag 5730 sal hoti hai - yani 5730 sal mein uski aadhi matara toot jaati hai; isi lambi ardhaayu ke karan ye 50,000 sal tak purane jaivik padarthon ki umar batane ke liye upyukt hai. Isliye har 5730 sal mein bachi hui matara aadhi hoti jaati hai (1/2, 1/4, 1/8 ...). Uranium-238 ki 4.5 billion sal, Radium-226 ki 1600 sal aur Tritium ki 12.3 sal hoti hai, isliye wo aankde C-14 ke liye sahi nahi. Exam point: Carbon-14 ki ardh-aayu ~5730 sal hoti hai; isi par radiocarbon dating tika hai (har 5730 sal mein matara aadhi).

qe: Which radioactive gas is found in homes and can cause Lung Cancer?
qh: घरों में कौन सी रेडियोधर्मी गैस पाई जाती है जो फेफड़ों के कैंसर का कारण बन सकती है?
e: Radon ek radioaktiv mahan (noble) gas hai jo uranium-rich mitti aur chatton se nikal kar gharon mein jama ho jaati hai (khaas kar basement mein); iskan ka saans ke saath andar jaana alpha vaikiran deta hai jo phephdon ki koshikaon ko hani pahunchata hai, isliye ye lung cancer ka doosra sabse bada karan maana jaata hai (dhumrapan ke baad). Isliye gharon mein ventilation aur radon-testing ki salah di jaati hai. Helium neon argon nishkriya (inert) hain aur urja-mukti nahi karte, isliye wo khatarnak nahi hain. Exam point: gharon mein milne wali radioaktiv gas = radon (Rn); ye alpha emitter hai aur phephdon ke cancer ka bada karan maana jaata hai.

qe: What happens to the 'Mass Number' during Alpha decay?
qh: अल्फा क्षय के दौरान 'द्रव्यमान संख्या' का क्या होता है?
e: Alpha kshaya mein bahar nikalne wala padarth helium-4 ke nabhik (2 proton + 2 neutron) jaisa hota hai, isliye nucleus se char nukleon kam ho jaate hain aur dravyaman kramank (mass number) mein 4 ki girawat hoti hai - jaise U-238 se Th-234 banta hai (238 - 4 = 234). Beta kshaya mein ek nukleon ka roop badalta hai isliye mass number wahi rehta hai, aur gamma emission mein koi nukleon nahi nikalta. Isliye '4 ki badhotri', '2 se kam' ya 'koi badlav nahi' jaise jod sahi nahi hain. Exam point: alpha kshaya mein mass number 4 ghatta hai (A - 4) aur atomic number 2 ghatta hai - kyunki nikalne wala kan helium nucleus jaisa hai.

qe: Which isotope is used as fuel in 'Nuclear Submarines'?
qh: 'परमाणु पनडुब्बियों' में ईंधन के रूप में किस समस्थानिक का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Nuclear submarine mein chhoti-si jagah par lambe samay tak bahut urja chahiye, isliye uske reactor mein samvardhit (enriched) uranium ka istemal hota hai - jisme U-235 ki matara prakrutik 0.7% se badha kar 20% ya adhik ki jaati hai, jisse reactor chhota ban jaata hai aur ek hi bhar se saaloon tak submarine chalti hai. Bhaari paani sirf moderator ka kaam karta hai (indhan nahi), aur thorium abhi mukhya indhan nahi hai. Isi karan submarine ko sadkon par bina baar-baar indhan bhare lambi doori tai karne ki kshamta milti hai. Exam point: nuclear submarine ka indhan = samvardhit (enriched) uranium (adhik U-235), jisse chhota reactor aur lambi avadhi ka indhan milta hai.

qe: What is a 'Positron'?
qh: 'पॉजिट्रॉन' क्या है?
e: Positron electron ka poshan (anti-particle) hota hai - dono ka dravyaman samaan hota hai, par positron par +1 aur electron par -1 aavesh hota hai; jab positron kisi electron se milta hai to dono vishleshan (annihilation) hokar do gama photons mein badal jaate hain, aur isi par PET scan ki chhavikaran vidhi tika hai. Isliye positron ko 'dhanaveshi electron' bhi kehte hain, aur ise 1932 mein Carl Anderson ne khoja tha. Proton ya neutron positron nahi hain kyunki unka dravyaman bahut adhik hota hai; neutrino ka aavesh hi shunya hota hai. Exam point: positron = electron ka poshan (anti-particle) - same dravyaman, par aavesh +1; electron se milne par do gama photon banti hain.

qe: The 'Stability' of a nucleus depends on which ratio?
qh: नाभिक की 'स्थिरता' किस अनुपात पर निर्भर करती है?
e: Nucleus ki sthirta usmein maujood neutron aur proton ke anupat (n/p ratio) par nirbhar karti hai - halke sthir nabhik mein ye anupat lagbhag 1 hota hai (jaise C-12), par bhaari nabhik mein vidyut vikarshan ko santulit karne ke liye neutron zyada chahiye hote hain, isliye anupat 1.5 tak pahunch jaata hai (jaise Pb-208). Anupat bahut kam ya bahut zyada hone par nucleus asthir ho jaata hai aur wo radioaktiv kshaya karta hai (n zyada hone par beta kshaya). Isliye 'mass/volume', 'electron/proton' ya 'charge/mass' wale anupat yahan sahi nahi hain. Exam point: nucleus ki sthirta n/p (neutron/proton) anupat par nirbhar karti hai - halke nabhik mein ~1 aur bhaari nabhik mein ~1.5 tak.

qe: Which radiation has the 'Lowest' penetrating power?
qh: किस विकिरण की भेदन क्षमता 'न्यूनतम' होती है?
e: Vaikiran ki bhedan-shakti (penetrating power) uske dravyaman aur aavesh par nirbhar karti hai - alpha kan sabse bhari (4 u) aur aavesh-yukt (+2) hone ke karan hawa aur padarth se sabse jaldi takra kar ruk jaata hai, isliye uski bhedan-shakti sabse kam hoti hai (kagaz ya kapde ki ek parat kaafi hai). Beta kan halka hota hai isliye aluminium ki patli chadar tak pahunchta hai, aur gamma kan nahi hone ke karan sabse andar tak jaata hai (sisa ki moti parat chahiye). Isliye 'beta' ya 'gamma' ka sabse kam hona galat hai. Exam point: sabse kam bhedan-shakti = alpha rays (sabse kam range), aur sabse adhik bhedan-shakti = gamma rays.

qe: What is 'Breeder Reactor'?
qh: 'ब्रीडर रिएक्टर' क्या है?
o: Reactor that produces more fuel than it consumes
e: Breeder reactor aisa reactor hota hai jo jitna indhan kharch karta hai usse zyada nayaa fissile indhan paida kar deta hai - jaise thorium-232 se U-233 ya U-238 se Pu-239 ban jaata hai, isliye iska breeding ratio 1 se adhik hota hai. Yahi karan Bharat ke teen-pad nuclear programme ka doosra pad fast breeder reactor hai, jisme thorium ko aage ke indhan mein badalne ki yojna hai (PFBR Kalpakkam). 'Sirf bijli banane wala', 'kam indhan banane wala' ya 'sirf waste ko sokhne wala' reactor breeder ki paribhasha nahi hai. Exam point: breeder reactor kharch kiye indhan se zyada naya fissile indhan banata hai (breeding ratio > 1), jaise Th-232 se U-233 aur U-238 se Pu-239.

qe: Which 'Rare Earth' radioactive element was discovered by Marie Curie?
qh: मैरी क्यूरी ने किस 'दुर्लभ' रेडियोधर्मी तत्व की खोज की थी?
e: Marie Curie ne pitchblende khaniz par kaam karke polonium aur radium khoje the - radium hi wo khaas radioaktiv padarth tha jiske liye unhe 1911 ka rasayan ka Nobel puraskar mila (radium se nikalti vaikiran ko andhere mein chamakte dekha jaata tha). Isliye 'Curie dwara khoja gaya radioactive element' ke roop mein radium sahi jod hai. Uranium pehle se jana jaata tha (Klaproth ne 1789 mein khoja), thorium Berzelius ne khoja tha, aur plutonium baad mein (1940) banaya gaya - isliye ye vikalp ghatna se match nahi karte. Exam point: Marie Curie ka khoja hua pramukh radioactive tatva = radium (aur polonium bhi); inhe pitchblende ore se alag kiya gaya tha.

qe: What is the 'Critical Mass' in a chain reaction?
qh: श्रृंखला अभिक्रिया में 'क्रांतिक द्रव्यमान' क्या है?
o: Min mass needed to sustain a chain reaction
e: Critical mass ek aisi nyoonatam matara hai jismein bache hue neutron agle viyojan (fission) ka kaam kar paate hain; isse kam matara par bahut se neutron bahar nikal jaate hain aur chain reaction ruk jaati hai, aur isse zyada par kriya tez hoti jaati hai. Bhatti mein isi baat ka dhyan rakh kar matara itni rakhi jaati hai ki multiplication factor k = 1 rahe, aur bomb mein critical mass tatha sahi aakaar (sphere) ka istemal hota hai taaki urja saamuhik (massive) roop mein nikaley.
