Isliye 'half-life se bada matara', 'neutron ki sankhya' ya 'reactor ka aakar' iski paribhasha nahi hain. Exam point: critical mass = indhan ki wo nyoonatam matara jis par neutron ki hani aur laabh barabar ho jaayein aur kriya khud chalti rahe.

qe: Which radioactive isotope is used to study the 'Thyroid Gland'?
qh: 'थायरॉयड ग्रंथि' के अध्ययन के लिए किस रेडियोधर्मी समस्थानिक का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Thyroid gland ke adhyayan ke liye Iodine-131 ka istemal hota hai kyunki thyroid iodine ko khud kheench leta hai; iske vaikiran ko 'gamma camera' se dekh kar ye pata chalta hai ki thyroid kitni iodine leta hai, kya usme koi ganth (nodule) ya kamzor (hypo) ya ati-kriya (hyper) wala bhaag hai. Isi wajah se aise scans aur 'uptake tests' hospital mein kiye jaate hain. Phosphorus-32 paudhon ke khad-adhyayan mein aur C-14 jeev-avshesh ki dating mein kaam aata hai, isliye ye dono yahan sahi jod nahi hain. Exam point: thyroid gland ke adhyayan aur scan ke liye Iodine-131 istemal hota hai, kyunki thyroid iodine ko sokh leta hai.

qe: What is the 'Magic Number' in nuclear physics?
qh: परमाणु भौतिकी में 'मैजिक नंबर' क्या है?
o: Numbers of nucleons that lead to extra stability
e: Magic numbers 2, 8, 20, 28, 50, 82 aur 126 hote hain - ye proton ya neutron ki wo sankhyein hain jin par shell poore bhar jaate hain (nuclear shell model ke anusar), isliye aise nucleus anya nabhikon se zyada sthir hote hain (jaise helium-4, oxygen-16, lead-208). Isi karan inhe 'magic' kaha jaata hai aur aise nabhik 'double magic' (proton aur neutron dono ki sankhya magic) hone par aur bhi sthir hote hain. Isliye 'atom ke kuchh nishchit charges', 'electron ke shell' ya 'random number' wale kathan yahan lagu nahi hote. Exam point: magic numbers = 2, 8, 20, 28, 50, 82, 126 - in sankhyaon par nucleus extra sthir hota hai (nuclear shell model).

qe: Which radiation is 'Positively' charged and has the same mass as Helium?
qh: कौन सा विकिरण 'धनावेशित' है और इसका द्रव्यमान हीलियम के समान है?
e: Wo vaikiran jo dhanaveshit (positive) ho aur jiska dravyaman helium ke atom ke barabar ho, wahi alpha kan hai - kyunki alpha keval do proton aur do neutron ka joda (helium nucleus) hota hai, isliye uska dravyaman lagbhag 4 u aur aavesh +2 hota hai. Beta kan electron jaisa halka (aavesh -1) hota hai aur gamma photon niraveshi (aavesh 0) hota hai, isliye wo is paribhasha mein nahi baithte. Isi karan alpha kirnein vidyut-chumbakiya kshetra mein rin-dhrub ki taraf mudti hain. Exam point: dhanaveshit aur helium ke dravyaman wala kan = alpha particle (2 proton + 2 neutron, aavesh +2, dravyaman lagbhag 4 u).

qe: What is the 'Moderator' used in India's nuclear reactors (CANDU type)?
qh: भारत के परमाणु रिएक्टरों में किस 'मंदक' का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Bharat ke zyadatar bhaari-paani reactor (PHWR, CANDU prakar) mein neutron-sanchodhak (moderator) ke roop mein bhaari paani (D2O) istemal hota hai, kyunki ye tez neutron ko dheema kar deta hai par unhe kam sokhta hai - isliye samvardhit uranium ke bina hi prakrutik uranium se kriya chalti rehti hai. Saadhaaran paani neutron sokh leta hai (isliye us reactor mein enrich karna padta hai) aur graphite ke reactors alag prakar ke hote hain. Yaad rakhein: bhaari paani coolant ka kaam bhi kar sakta hai, par uska mukhya kaam moderator hona hai. Exam point: Bharat ke CANDU-prakar reactors mein moderator = bhaari paani (D2O); isme tez neutron dheeme ho jaate hain par unka sokhna bahut kam hota hai.

qe: Which process is used in an 'Atomic Bomb'?
qh: 'परमाणु बम' में किस प्रक्रिया का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Atomic bomb mein U-235 ya Pu-239 ka asanrakshit (uncontrolled) viyojan (fission) hota hai - ismein ek neutron se do-teen naye neutron bante hain aur ye shrinkhala (chain) bahut hi kam samay mein poori matara ko todi deti hai, jisse vismarak urja-mukti hoti hai. Reactor mein yahi kriya control rods se niyantrit roop mein chalti hai (k = 1), isliye dono mein mool antar niyantran ka hai. Fusion hydrogen bomb ka aadhaar hai, aur rasayanik jalna (combustion) se itni urja nahi mil sakti. Exam point: atomic bomb = asanrakshit nuclear fission (U-235/Pu-239), jabki reactor mein niyantrit (controlled) fission hoti hai.

qe: What is 'Decay Constant' ($\lambda$)?
qh: 'क्षय स्थिरांक' ($\lambda$) क्या है?
o: Probability of decay per unit time
e: Decay constant (lambda) batata hai ki kisi ek nabhik ke ek second mein tootne ki sambhavna (probability) kitni hai; iski ikai s^-1 hoti hai aur ye padarth ke liye sthir hota hai (tapman, dabav ya rasayanik sthiti se nahi badalta). Activity A = lambda x N ke roop mein likhi jaati hai, aur lambda = 0.693 / t(half) se aadha-aayu se juda hota hai. Isliye 'kul atom', 'ardhaayu ki sankhya' ya 'vaikiran ki urja' iski paribhasha nahi hain. Exam point: decay constant lambda = prati ekak samay kshaya hone ki sambhavna (ikai s^-1), aur activity A = lambda N tatha lambda = 0.693/t(half).

qe: Which radioactive isotope is used in 'Smoke Detectors'?
qh: 'धुआं डिटेक्टरों' में किस रेडियोधर्मी समस्थानिक का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Smoke detector mein Americium-241 jaise alpha-chhodne wale isotope ki bahut chhoti matara hoti hai; iski alpha kirnein hawa ke kanon ko ionise karke ek halki vidyut-dhara banati hain, aur dhuaan andar ghuste hi ye dhara ruk jaati hai - isse alarm baj jaata hai. Isliye gharon ke detector mein yahi isotope sabse aam hai (ye surakshit matara mein bandh rehta hai). Sodium-24, C-14 aur I-131 is kaam ke liye nahi hote kyunki unki vaikiran ki sifat aur aadha-aayu is kam ke liye theek nahi. Exam point: smoke detector mein Americium-241 istemal hota hai; iski alpha kirnein hawa ko ionise karke dhara banati hain, jo dhuaan se tut jaati hai.

qe: What happens to the 'Atomic Number' during Beta-minus decay?
qh: बीटा-माइनस क्षय के दौरान 'परमाणु संख्या' का क्या होता है?
e: Beta-minus kshaya mein neutron ka roop badal kar proton ban jaata hai, isliye nucleus mein ek dhanaavesh (positive) kam hota hai aur ek rinavesh (negative) badhta hai - natija yahi hai ki atomic number ek se badh jaata hai (aur mass number wahi rehta hai). Udaharan: carbon-14 se nitrogen-14 banta hai (Z 6 se 7 ho jaata hai). Positron kshaya aur electron capture mein atomic number ek kam hoti hai, aur alpha kshaya mein do kam hoti hai - isliye wo vikalp beta-minus ke sahi jod nahi hain. Exam point: beta-minus kshaya mein atomic number 1 se badh jaata hai (Z + 1), kyunki neutron proton mein badal jaata hai.

qe: What is the 'Fuel' used in a Hydrogen Bomb?
qh: हाइड्रोजन बम में किस 'ईंधन' का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Hydrogen bomb ka indhan hydrogen ke bhaari isotopes - deuterium (2H) aur tritium (3H) - hote hain, jo bahut uchch tapman par mil kar helium banate hain; vyavhar mein inhe lithium deuteride (LiD) jaise thos padarth ke roop mein rakha jaata hai, jise pehle fission bomb ki garmi se jalaya jaata hai. Isliye ise 'thermonuclear' bomb bhi kehte hain. Uranium ya plutonium fission ka indhan hain (wo trigger/heavy outer layer ka kaam karte hain), par bomb ki mukhya urja fusion se aati hai. Exam point: hydrogen bomb ka indhan = hydrogen ke isotope deuterium aur tritium (LiD ke roop mein), jo fusion karke helium banate hain.

qe: Which unit is used to measure 'Radiation Dose' absorbed by human tissue?
qh: मानव ऊतक द्वारा अवशोषित 'विकिरण खुराक' को मापने के लिए किस इकाई का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Radiation ke jaivik (biological) asar ka maap sievert (Sv) mein hota hai - ye 'equivalent dose' batata hai, jisme vaikiran ki urja ke saath-saath us padarth ka 'quality factor' bhi shamil hota hai (alpha ka khatra 20 guna maana jaata hai, beta/gamma ka 1). Isliye ek hi Gray dose alpha se beta ke mukable zyada hani deta hai; isi karan sievert ko 'dose equivalent' ka unit kehte hain. Gray keval absorbed urja per kilogram batata hai aur curie activity ka maap hai - isliye wo vikalp is paribhasha ke nahi hain. Exam point: human tissue par pade radiation ke asar ka maap = sievert (Sv); ye absorbed dose (Gray) ko radiation ke khatra-gunaank (quality factor) se guna karke milta hai.

qe: What is 'Nuclear Spallation'?
qh: 'न्यूक्लियर स्पैलेशन' क्या है?
o: Ejection of many small fragments by high energy impact
e: Nuclear spallation ek aisi kriya hai jismein bahut tez urja wala kan (jaise proton) kisi bhaari nucleus par gira kar us se ek saath bahut se chhote tukde (nucleons aur halke nabhik) bahar nikaal deta hai; ise 'bhari nucleus ka chhidna' keh sakte hain. Isi vidhi se scientific laboratory mein neutron ki tez dhara (spallation neutron source) paida ki jaati hai. Alpha kshaya, beta kshaya ya fission mein itne tukde ek saath nahi nikalte - isliye wo vikalp spallation ki sahi vyakhya nahi hain. Exam point: nuclear spallation = uchch-urja kan ki takkar se nucleus se bahut se chhote tukde nikalna; isi se spallation neutron source banta hai.

qe: Which radioactive isotope is used as a 'Tracer' in agriculture?
qh: कृषि में 'ट्रेसर' के रूप में किस रेडियोधर्मी समस्थानिक का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Khad (fertilizer) ke upyog ke adhyayan ke liye Phosphorus-32 ko khad ke saath paudhon ko diya jaata hai; wo paudhe ke andar phosphorus ke saath hi chalta hai, isliye vaikiran maap kar ye pata chalta hai ki paudha kitna aur kis hisse mein phosphorus leta hai (fertilizer use efficiency). Isi tarika se 'fertilizer use efficiency', paudhon ki vridhi aur pulse crop ke saath P-32 ka adhyayan kiya jaata hai. C-14 photosynthesis ke liye, I-131 thyroid ke liye aur Na-24 khoon ke bahav ke liye hote hain - isliye wo vikalp yahan sahi nahi. Exam point: agriculture mein tracer ke roop mein Phosphorus-32 istemal hota hai (khad ke phosphorus ka paudhon mein aavan-javan janne ke liye).

qe: What is the charge of a 'Positron'?
qh: 'पॉजिट्रॉन' का आवेश क्या होता है?
e: Positron ek dhanaveshi (positive) kan hai jiska aavesh electron ke bilkul ulta (+1) hota hai; ise 'beta-plus' kan bhi kehte hain aur ye proton ke neutron mein badalne par nucleus se nikalta hai. Photon niraveshi hota hai, electron ka aavesh -1 hota hai, aur neutron ka bhi aavesh shunya hota hai - isliye inmein se koi positron nahi hai. Positron kisi electron se milte hi do gama photon banata hai (annihilation), isi par PET scan chalti hai. Exam point: positron ka aavesh +1 hota hai (electron ka poshan/anti-particle); iski speed aur dravyaman electron ke barabar hote hain.

qe: Which radiation has the 'Highest' ionizing power?
qh: किस विकिरण में 'उच्चतम' आयनकारी शक्ति होती है?
e: Ionising shakti padarth ke kanon se kriya karne ki kshamta hai; alpha kan bhaari aur dhanaveshit hone ke karan hawa ke atoms se sabse tez kriya karta hai, isliye raste ke har centimetre mein bahut ionon ka joda banata hai - isi karan alpha ki ionising shakti sabse zyada hoti hai. Beta kan madhyam ionising hota hai aur gamma mein aavesh na hone ke karan ionisation sabse kam hota hai (uski urja secondary electrons ke zariye kharch hoti hai). Isliye 'beta' ya 'gamma' ka highest hona galat hai. Exam point: sabse adhik ionising shakti = alpha rays; isliye shareer ke andar pahunchne par alpha sabse zyada hani karta hai (bahar se kapde se ruk jaata hai).

qe: What is 'Nuclear Isomerism'?
qh: 'परमाणु समावयवता' क्या है?
o: Same A and Z but different energy states
e: Nuclear isomerism mein do nabhik ke proton (Z) aur neutron sankhya ek jaise hote hain, par unki andar ki urja ki avastha alag hoti hai - isliye unki half-life aur kshaya ka tarika alag dikhta hai, halanki wo ek hi tatva ke roop hain. Udaharan technetium-99m, jise hospital mein chhavikaran (imaging) ke liye istemal karte hain kyunki wo sirf gama chhodta hai. Isotope mein neutron ki sankhya alag hoti hai aur isobar mein mass number ek hota hai - isliye wo vikalp isomerism ki sahi vyakhya nahi hain. Exam point: isomerism = ek hi Z aur A par alag urja avastha (metastable), jaise Tc-99m; isliye half-life alag hoti hai.

qe: Which material is used to wrap 'Radioactive waste' for burial?
qh: दफनाने के लिए 'रेडियोधर्मी कचरे' को लपेटने के लिए किस सामग्री का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Radioaktiv awshesh (waste) ko surakshit taur par bandh karne ke liye bahu-parat (multilayer) shield istemal hoti hai - sabse andar mazbut metal ki can, uske baad lead ki parat (gamma rokne ke liye) aur sabse bahar moti concrete ki parat (vaikiran aur garmi rokne ke liye). Isi tarika se waste ko bhoomi mein dabane se pehle taiyar kiya jaata hai, kyunki koi bhi ek padarth saari vaikiran nahi rok sakta. Plastic ya lakdi ke dabbe vaikiran rok nahi sakte; isliye unka istemal sambhav nahi. Exam point: radioactive waste ko bandh karne ke liye lead aur concrete jaisi bahu-parat shielding istemal hoti hai (andar metal canister, phir lead, phir concrete).

qe: What is 'Average Life' ($\tau$) of a radioactive substance?
qh: रेडियोधर्मी पदार्थ की 'औसत आयु' ($\tau$) क्या है?
e: Average life (average life) kisi radioaktiv padarth ke ek atom ke tootne tak ke ausat samay ko kehte hai; ganit se ye decay constant ka vyutkram (1/lambda) hota hai aur half-life se thoda zyada (half-life ka 1.44 guna) nikalta hai. Isliye ye half-life se bada hota hai (half-life ka 1.44 guna) aur '1/lambda' wala roop sahi hai. '2 x half-life', 'half-life/2' ya 'lambda' aise roop iski paribhasha nahi hain. Exam point: average life (tau) = 1/lambda = 1.44 x half-life; isliye ye half-life se thoda bada hota hai.

qe: Which 'Law' is followed by radioactive decay?
qh: रेडियोधर्मी क्षय किस 'नियम' का पालन करता है?
e: Radioactive kshaya ki gati us samay shesh (bache hue) nabhikon ki ginti ke samanupati hoti hai, isliye ise pratham koti (first order) ki kinetiks kehte hain - isi karan rate constant ki ikai s^-1 hoti hai aur half-life shuruaati matara se svatantra rehti hai. Yahi niyam batata hai ki har padarth ki apni nishchit half-life kyun hoti hai (jaise C-14 ki 5730 sal, P-32 ki 14.3 din). Zero, second ya third order kinetics kshaya ke liye sahi nahi hain. Exam point: radioactive kshaya pratham koti (first-order) kinetiks ka palan karta hai, kyunki gati shesh nabhikon ki ginti par nirbhar hoti hai aur half-life sthir rehti hai.

qe: Which radioactive isotope is used as a 'Fuel' in the Curiosity Rover on Mars?
qh: मंगल ग्रह पर क्यूरियोसिटी रोवर में ईंधन के रूप में किस रेडियोधर्मी समस्थानिक का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Curiosity jaisi Mars rover ko saaloon tak bijli chahiye hoti hai aur suraj ki roshni kam ya dhool ke karan solar panel kam pad jaate hain, isliye usme Plutonium-238 wale radioisotope thermoelectric generator (RTG) istemal hote hain - Pu-238 ki alpha-garmi thermocouple se bijli mein badalti hai. Iski aadha-aayu lagbhag 87 sal hoti hai, isliye ek hi bhar se rovers saaloon tak chalte hain. Uranium-235 fission reactor si jagah/bhaar maangta hai, isliye chhote rovers ke liye theek nahi. Exam point: Mars rover (Curiosity/Perseverance) ka indhan-cell = Plutonium-238 (RTG); isse saaloon tak sthiri bijli milti hai.

qe: What is 'Nuclear Spallation' used to produce?
qh: 'परमाणु स्पैलेशन' (Nuclear Spallation) का उपयोग क्या उत्पन्न करने के लिए किया जाता है?
e: Nuclear spallation se aane wale bahut se neutron ka istemal karke scientific anusandhan ke liye neutron beams banaaye jaate hain - aise yantra ko spallation neutron source kehte hain, jismein tez proton bhaari target par girta hai aur neutron ki tez dhara nikalti hai. In neutron beams se padarth ke dhanche, magnetik gun aur material science ka adhyayan hota hai. Bijli utpadan, khad nirmaan ya radioaktiv dating is kriya ke seedhe upyog nahi hain - isliye wo vikalp yahan sahi nahi. Exam point: nuclear spallation ka pramukh upyog = neutron beams paida karna (spallation neutron source), jisse material aur atomic dhanche ka adhyayan hota hai.

qe: Which part of the 'Sun' is where nuclear fusion occurs?
qh: सूर्य के किस 'भाग' में परमाणु संलयन होता है?
e: Surya ke andar fusion keval core (kendra) mein hota hai, kyunki sirf wahin tapman lagbhag 1.5 crore degree C aur itna dabav hota hai jo hydrogen nuclei ko milane ke liye chahiye; core ki ye urja aage radiative aur convective zone se hokar satah tak pahunchti hai. Outer layers (photosphere, chromosphere, corona) mein tapman aur ghanatva itne kam ho jaate hain ki fusion nahi ho sakta (corona garam hota hai par usme padarth bahut patla hota hai). Isliye 'photosphere', 'corona' ya 'chromosphere' wale vikalp sahi nahi hain. Exam point: Surya mein nuclear fusion uske core (kendra) mein hota hai - wahin lagbhag 1.5 crore C tapman aur adhik dabav hota hai.

qe: What is the 'Decay Series' of Uranium-238 called?
qh: यूरेनियम-238 की 'क्षय श्रृंखला' को क्या कहा जाता है?
e: Uranium-238 ke kshaya se bani shrinkhala uranium-radium series kehlati hai; iska nishchit swaroop 4n+2 hai (kyunki 238 ko 4 se bhaag dene par 2 shesh bachta hai), aur iska antim sthir padarth lead-206 hota hai - isi shrinkhala mein radium (Ra-226) bhi aata hai, jise Curie dmpati ne alag kiya tha. Thorium series (4n) aur neptunium series (4n+1) anya series hain, isliye wo vikalp yahan sahi nahi hain. Exam point: U-238 ki kshaya shrinkhala = uranium-radium series (4n+2), jo radium ke pad se hokar lead-206 par samapt hoti hai.

qe: Which 'Mineral' is the main source of Uranium in India (Jaduguda mines)?
qh: भारत (जादुगुडा खदानों) में यूरेनियम का मुख्य स्रोत कौन सा 'खनिज' है?
e: Bharat mein uranium mukhya roop se Jharkhand ke Jaduguda (UCIL ki khaan) se nikalta hai, jahan ye pitchblende/uraninite khaniz ke roop mein milta hai; isi ke saath Tummalapalle (Andhra Pradesh) mein bhi bada bhandar mila hai. Pitchblende mein uranium ka oxide hota hai, isliye khaniz ka naam pitchblende hi sahi jod hai. Iron ore, bauxite aur mica Bharatiya mukhya khaniz hain par unmein uranium nahi hota, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: Bharat mein uranium ka mukhya srot = pitchblende (Jaduguda, Jharkhand - UCIL), jisse uranium oxide nikalta hai.

qe: What is 'K-Electron Capture' effect on the Atomic Number?
qh: परमाणु संख्या पर 'K-इलेक्ट्रॉन कैप्चर' का क्या प्रभाव पड़ता है?
e: K-electron capture mein nucleus andar ki K-kaksha ka electron sokh leta hai; wo electron proton ke saath mil kar neutron ban jaata hai, isliye nucleus mein ek proton kam ho jaata hai aur atomic number ek se ghat jaata hai (mass number wahi rehta hai). Iske baad K-kaksha khaali hone se khaas X-ray nikalti hai, jise detector se pehchana jaata hai. Beta-minus kshaya mein atomic number badhta hai, alpha mein do kam hoti hai, aur gamma mein koi badlav nahi - isliye wo vikalp K-capture ke sahi jod nahi hain. Exam point: K-electron capture se atomic number 1 se ghat jaata hai (Z - 1) aur khaas X-ray nikalti hai.

qe: Which radiation is 'Highest' in ionizing power but 'Lowest' in penetration?
qh: किस विकिरण की आयनकारी शक्ति 'उच्चतम' लेकिन भेदन क्षमता 'न्यूनतम' होती है?
e: Alpha kan ka dravyaman bhaari (4 u) aur aavesh do guna hota hai, isliye wo padarth ke atomon se sabse tez kriya karta hai - matlab uski ionising shakti sabse adhik hoti hai; par isi karan wo hawa mein bahut chhoti doori mein urja khota hai aur sabse kam andar tak pahunchta hai (bhedan shakti sabse kam). Isliye 'highest ionisation + lowest penetration' wala jod alpha ka hi hai. Beta madhyam ionisation karta hai aur gamma ka ulta hota hai (sabse kam ionise, sabse adhik penetrate). Exam point: alpha rays - ionising power sabse zyada par penetrating power sabse kam; gamma rays - ionising power sabse kam par penetrating power sabse zyada.

qe: What is 'Criticality' in a nuclear reactor?
qh: परमाणु रिएक्टर में 'क्रिटिकैलिटी' (Criticality) क्या है?
e: Nuclear reactor mein 'criticality' wo avastha hai jismein shrinkhala (chain) kriya ka balance bana rehta hai - yani ek peedhi ke neutron kshaya (loss) aur agle viyojan (fission) barabar ho jaate hain, jisse multiplication factor k = 1 hota hai aur urja-mukti sthir rehti hai. Agar k < 1 ho to kriya dheemi padkar band ho jaati hai aur k > 1 ho to kriya bahut tez ho jaati hai (visfot ka khatra). Isliye 'neutron ka bilkul khatam hona', 'fuel ka khatam hona' ya 'coolant ka rukna' criticality nahi hain. Exam point: criticality = balanced chain reaction (k = 1) ki avastha, jisme reactor sthiri urja deta rehta hai.

qe: Which radioactive isotope is used in 'Brachytherapy' for eye cancer?
qh: आंखों के कैंसर के लिए 'ब्रेकीथेरेपी' में किस रेडियोधर्मी समस्थानिक का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Iodine-125 ke chhote 'seeds' (capsules) aankh ke cancer (retinoblastoma/melanoma) mein bahut hi paas rakh kar ilaaj kiya jaata hai, kyunki iski kam-urja wali gama kirnein sirf as-paas ke ootak par asar karti hain aur aankh ke nazuk hisse bach jaate hain (isi 'plaque brachytherapy' kehte hain). Isi tarah prostate cancer mein bhi I-125 seeds ka istemal hota hai. Cobalt-60 thok (external) therapy ke liye aur P-32 khad-adhyayan ke liye hota hai - isliye wo vikalp is prashn ke sahi jod nahi. Exam point: aankh ke cancer ki brachytherapy ke liye Iodine-125 (kam-urja gama seeds) istemal hota hai, jo sirf ootak par asar karta hai.

qe: What is the 'Average Life' ($\tau$) of a radioactive element with half-life $T_{1/2}$?
qh: अर्ध-आयु $T_{1/2}$ वाले रेडियोधर्मी तत्व की 'औसत आयु' ($\tau$) क्या है?
e: Half-life T(half) aur average life (tau) mein seedha sambandh hota hai: tau = 1/lambda = T(half)/0.693 = 1.44 x T(half) - yani average life half-life se lagbhag ek-aur-sawa-guna (1.44 guna) hoti hai. Yahi karan hai ki aadhe atom toot jaane ke baad bhi bache hue atomon ko poora tootne mein thoda zyada samay lagta hai. '0.693 x T', 'T/1.44' ya '2 x T' aise sambandh ganit se match nahi karte. Exam point: average life tau = 1.44 x half-life (aur 1/lambda), kyunki kuchh atom half-life se pehle aur kuchh baad mein tootte hain.

qe: Which radioactive isotope is used to determine the age of 'Organic remains' like wood or bone?
qh: लकड़ी या हड्डी जैसे 'जैविक अवशेषों' की आयु निर्धारित करने के लिए किस रेडियोधर्मी समस्थानिक का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Purane jaivik avshesh - lakdi, haddi, koyla, kagaz ya chitrakari ke aadhaar - mein bacha hua Carbon-14 dekh kar unki umar nikali jaati hai, kyunki jeev jeete ji C-14 ka santulan bana rehta hai aur mrityu ke baad wo 5730 sal ki half-life ke saath ghatta hai. Isi liye 'radiocarbon dating' se lagbhag 50,000 sal tak purane jaivik padarthon ki umar batayi jaati hai (isliye chatton ke liye ye vidhi nahi chalti). Uranium-lead jaisi vidhiyan mineral ke liye hoti hain, isliye wo vikalp yahan sahi nahi. Exam point: lakdi ya haddi jaise jaivik avshesh ki umar = Carbon-14 (radiocarbon dating, half-life 5730 sal, seema ~50,000 sal).

qe: What is the function of the 'Coolant' in a nuclear reactor?
qh: परमाणु रिएक्टर में 'शीतलक' (Coolant) का क्या कार्य है?
o: To absorb heat from the core
e: Reactor ke coolant ka mukhya kaam core ki garmi sokh kar ushe bahar le jaana hai - wo us garmi se bhaap banata hai ya secondary loop ko garmi deta hai, jisse turbine aur bijli-utpadan ka chakra chalta hai; saath hi coolant core ko atyadhik garm hone se bachata hai. Isi liye coolant ke roop mein bhaari paani, halka paani, CO2 gas ya drav sodium jaise padarth chune jaate hain. Moderator neutron dheema karta hai, control rod neutron sokhta hai aur shield vaikiran rokta hai - isliye wo vikalp coolant ke kaam nahi hain. Exam point: coolant ka kaam = core se garmi le jaana (aur turbine ko dena), jisse reactor thanda rehta hai aur bijli banti hai.

qe: What is the 'SI Unit' of absorbed radiation dose?
qh: अवशोषित विकिरण खुराक की 'SI इकाई' क्या है?
e: Absorbed dose (yani padarth ke prati kilogram mein sokhi gayi urja) ki SI ikai gray (Gy) hai, jahan 1 Gy = 1 joule per kilogram; iska naam Louis Harold Gray ke naam par pada. Dose equivalent (jaivik asar) ke liye sievert (Sv) istemal hota hai, aur activity ke liye bequerel - isliye wo doosre maap ke unit hain. Isliye radiation ke absorbed dose ke liye sahi jod gray (Gy) hai. Exam point: absorbed radiation dose ki SI ikai = gray (1 Gy = 1 J/kg); sievert dose-equivalent ka maap hai aur bequerel activity ka.

qe: Which type of 'Nuclear Reaction' is responsible for the energy of a Hydrogen Bomb?
qh: हाइड्रोजन बम की ऊर्जा के लिए किस प्रकार की 'परमाणु अभिक्रिया' जिम्मेदार है?
e: Hydrogen bomb ki mukhya urja halke nabhik ke jurne (fusion) se aati hai - ismein deuterium aur tritium milkar helium banate hain, aur yahi kriya Surya mein bhi chalti hai; isiliye aise bomb ko thermonuclear bomb bhi kehte hain. Fission ka istemal sirf itni garmi paida karne ke liye trigger ke roop mein hota hai, aur visfot ki zyadatar urja fusion se hi nikalti hai. Rasayanik abhikarmak ya radioaktiv kshaya se itni urja nahi mil sakti, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: hydrogen bomb ki urja ka mukhya srot = nuclear fusion (deuterium + tritium se helium); fission sirf trigger ka kaam karta hai.

qe: Which 'Rare Gas' is produced during the radioactive decay of Radium?
qh: रेडियम के रेडियोधर्मी क्षय के दौरान कौन सी 'दुर्लभ गैस' उत्पन्न होती है?
e: Radium-226 ke tootne par radon gas (Rn-222) banti hai, jo khud radioactive mahan (noble) gas hai - isliye purane radium wale paint aur khanizon se radon nikalti rehti hai aur gharon ki neev (basement) mein jama ho jaati hai. Radon alpha chhodti hai, isliye saans ke saath andar jaane par phephdon ki koshikaon ko hani pahunchati hai aur cancer ka khatra badhata hai. Helium aur neon sthir gasen hain jo is kshaya se nahi banti, aur argon bhi sthir hai - isliye wo vikalp yahan sahi nahi. Exam point: radium ke kshaya se nikalne wali radioactive gas = radon (Rn-222); ye gharon ki neev mein jama hokar phephdon ke cancer ka khatra badhati hai.

qe: What is 'Nuclear Waste' primarily stored in for safety?
qh: सुरक्षा के लिए 'परमाणु कचरे' को मुख्य रूप से किसमें संग्रहित किया जाता है?
e: Nuclear waste ko surakshit rakhne ke liye ushe pehle shital (cooling) tank mein rakha jaata hai, phir vitrification (kaanch mein milana) karke mazbut steel canisters mein bandha jaata hai aur inhe lead-lined containers ya concrete vaults (on-surface storage) mein rakha jaata hai - taaki gamma kirnein aur bhaap bahar na nikaley. Isliye lead aur concrete jaisi paraten hi surakshit storage ka aadhaar hain (plastic ya lakdi ka dabba aise kaam ke liye bilkul nahi hai). Iske baad unhe gehri chatton (deep geological repository) mein dafnane ka plan banta hai. Exam point: nuclear waste ki surakshit storage = lead-lined containers ya concrete vaults (andar vitrified canisters), jisse vaikiran bahar nahi nikal paati.

qe: Which isotope is used in 'Brachytherapy' to treat prostate cancer?
qh: प्रोस्टेट कैंसर के इलाज के लिए 'ब्रेकीथेरेपी' में किस समस्थानिक का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Prostate cancer ke ilaaj mein Iodine-125 ke chhote seeds (lagbhag 4-5 mm ke capsule) gland ke andar lagaye jaate hain, aur ye apni kam-urja gama kirnein keval aas-paas ke ootak ko dete hain - isliye aas-paas ke ang (rectum, bladder) bache rehte hain. Yahi 'permanent seed brachytherapy' kehlati hai aur ise I-125 ya Pd-103 jaise isotope se kiya jaata hai. Cobalt-60 bahari therapy ke liye, P-32 khad adhyayan ke liye aur C-14 dating ke liye hota hai - isliye wo vikalp yahan sahi nahi hain. Exam point: prostate cancer ki brachytherapy ke liye Iodine-125 seeds istemal hote hain, jo gland ke andar hi apni gama urja chhodte hain.

qe: What is the 'Half-life' of Phosphorus-32 used in agriculture?
qh: कृषि में प्रयुक्त फास्फोरस-32 की 'अर्ध-आयु' क्या है?
e: Phosphorus-32 ki ardhaayu lagbhag 14.3 din hoti hai - yani har 14.3 din mein bacha hua aadha hissa kshaya ho jaata hai; itni kam aadha-aayu hone ke karan hi ye khad adhyayan, paudhon ki vridhi aur cancer ke ilaaj-adhyayan ke liye upyukt hota hai, kyunki ghatna bahut tezi se hoti hai isliye jaldi jaanch ho jaati hai. Iodine-131 ki 8 din, Cobalt-60 ki 5.3 sal aur C-14 ki 5730 sal hoti hai - isliye wo aankde P-32 ke liye sahi nahi hain. Exam point: Phosphorus-32 ki half-life lagbhag 14.3 din hoti hai; isiliye agriculture aur biological tracer ke roop mein ye jaldi jaanch deta hai.

qe: Which 'Discovery' led to the development of the Atomic Bomb?
qh: किस 'खोज' के कारण परमाणु बम का विकास हुआ?
e: Nuclear fission ki khoj (Otto Hahn aur Fritz Strassmann dwara 1938 mein, vyakhya Lise Meitner ne di) ne ye dikhaya ki bhaari nucleus neutron ki takkar se toot kar urja deta hai aur usse agle neutron nikalte hain - isi tathya se shrinkhala (chain) kriya ka idea bana aur atomic bomb tatha nuclear reactor dono ka raasta khula. Isliye 'fission ki khoj' hi wo discovery hai jise atomic bomb ka aadhaar maana jaata hai. Radioaktivta ki khoj (Becquerel) ya electron ki khoj is vidhi se seedha jude nahi. Exam point: atomic bomb banane ka aadhaar = nuclear fission ki khoj (Hahn-Strassmann, 1938), kyunki isme bhaari nucleus toot kar urja deta hai aur chain reaction chalti hai.

qe: What is 'Nuclear Enrichment'?
qh: 'परमाणु संवर्धन' (Nuclear Enrichment) क्या है?
o: Increasing the percent of U-235 in uranium
e: Nuclear enrichment ka matlab hai uranium mein U-235 ki pratishat badhana - prakrutik uranium mein U-235 keval 0.7% hota hai, jise reactor ke liye 3-5% aur weapons ke liye 90% se adhik kiya jaata hai; iske liye gas centrifuge ya gaseous diffusion jaisi vidhiyan istemal hoti hain. Yahi karan hai ki samvardhit (enriched) uranium se chhote reactor chalte hain aur yahi samvardhan ka antara-lal sambandh banata hai. 'Uranium ka khaniz se nikaalna' ya 'radium bhaar kam karna' enrichment nahi hai. Exam point: nuclear enrichment = uranium mein U-235 ki pratishat badhana (0.7% se 3-5% reactor grade, 90%+ weapons grade) - gas centrifuge jaise tarikon se.
